title: MANAGER SHOPIFY
description:
🚀 WE'RE HIRING: Customer Service Manager (E-commerce)



We are looking for an experienced Customer Service Manager to take full responsibility for our e-commerce customer support department.



You will be responsible for managing a team of 2 Customer Support Agents, supervising their daily activities, resolving operational issues, and ensuring that all customer requests, orders, and shipping problems are handled efficiently.



Your Responsibilities:



- Team Management:Lead, supervise, and coordinate 2 Customer Support Agents, ensuring they complete their daily tasks correctly and on time.

- Task Management: Assign tasks, monitor progress, check completed work, and ensure nothing is overlooked.

- Problem Solving: Act as the main point of contact whenever team members encounter difficulties, providing clear instructions and effective solutions.

- Shipping & Logistics: Oversee shipping operations, monitor delayed orders, handle delivery issues, and coordinate with our logistics partners when necessary.

- Customer Service Quality:Monitor customer conversations across
, WhatsApp, and social media to ensure professional, accurate, and timely responses.

- Escalation Management: Handle complex customer complaints, refunds, returns, and other situations requiring management intervention.

- Process Improvement: Identify recurring problems, improve internal workflows, and create clear guidelines for the support team.

- Weekly Reporting: Provide a detailed weekly report directly to the business owner, including:

- Individual performance of both support agents

- Tasks completed and pending

- Customer complaints and recurring issues

- Shipping delays and logistics problems

- Areas requiring improvement

- Recommendations and priorities for the following week



Requirements:



- Previous experience as a Customer Service Manager, Team Leader, or Customer Support Supervisor, preferably in e-commerce.

- Strong leadership, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

- Experience with Shopify and customer support platforms (Gorgias is a plus).

- Ability to work independently and make operational decisions.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong attention to detail and accountability.

- Experience managing shipping issues, refunds, returns, and logistics coordination.



What We're Looking For:



We don't need someone who simply answers customer messages.



We need a proactive, reliable leader who takes full ownership of the entire Customer Service Department, makes sure the team performs efficiently, solves problems before they escalate, and keeps the business owner informed through clear weekly reports.



Our Goal: Build a well-organized, efficient customer service department that can operate independently without constant supervision.



📩 To Apply: Send us a short introduction, your previous experience managing customer support teams, and the e-commerce platforms you've worked with.



Please apply only if you have relevant management experience.

title: AI Video Editor: Long-Form AI Ads (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
We’re a fast-growing US supplement brand running ads on Meta, TikTok, Amazon and TV. Most of our winning ads right now are long-form AI videos: drama stories, songs and Pixar-style animation. We need editors who can make them fast and well.



WHAT YOU NEED

- DTC ad experience. You know an ad exists to sell. You understand hooks, retention, pacing, how to show a problem and its payoff, and why the first 3 seconds d
 everything.

- Visuals that match the words. Every line of the script gets the visual that sells it best. You can’t fill a scene with something random just because it looks nice. And no AI slop: no warped faces or hands, and no characters who change from shot to shot.

- One AI-heavy video per day, up to 5 minutes long.

title: Senior E-commerce Web Developer
description:
🚀 WE'RE HIRING: Senior E-commerce Web Developer | Shopify, Funnelish, Checkout Champ, AI Automation & Meta/Google Ads



Job Type: Full-Time / Long-Term  

Work Location: Remote 

Experience Level: Senior / Expert



## About the Role



We are a fast-growing international e-commerce company looking for a highly experienced Senior E-commerce Web Developer with advanced expertise in Shopify, sales funnels, conversion rate optimization, AI automation, and digital advertising platforms.



We are NOT looking for a basic web developer, graphic designer, or someone who only knows how to use Shopify.



We need a true all-around e-commerce expert who can independently manage the entire technical and commercial ecosystem of an online store: from product pages and sales funnels to checkout optimization, post-purchase offers, automations, and advertising integrations.



The ideal candidate must have extensive knowledge of advanced e-commerce tools, execute tasks extremely quickly, and proactively identify opportunities to increase sales, conversions, and profitability.



Speed, independence, technical expertise, problem-solving, and execution are essential.



## 📌 Key Responsibilities



### 1. Shopify – Advanced Expertise



- Build, customize, manage, and optimize Shopify stores.

- Develop high-converting landing pages and product pages.

- Work with Shopify, PageFly, and other professional page builders.

- Customize Shopify themes, sections, and store functionality.

- Configure products, bundles, discounts, promotions, and special offers.

- Integrate third-party applications and external tools.

- Optimize website speed, mobile experience, and conversion rates.

- Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues quickly.

- Implement custom functionality using Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript when necessary.



### 2. Funnelish & Checkout Champ – Advanced Funnel Development



We are specifically looking for someone with strong practical experience using Funnelish and Checkout Champ.



Responsibilities include:



- Building complete, high-converting sales funnels.

- Creating conversion-focused landing pages.

- Setting up and optimizing checkout pages.

- Implementing order bumps, upsells, downsells, and cross-sells.

- Building one-click post-purchase offers.

- Creating and optimizing post-purchase pages.

- Configuring funnels with multiple offers, bundles, and pricing strategies.

- Integrating funnels with Shopify and payment processors.

- Setting up tracking, conversion events, and attribution.

- Running A/B tests to improve funnel performance.

- Identifying and fixing checkout and funnel issues.



You must understand the complete customer journey, from the first ad click to checkout, purchase, and post-purchase offers.



### 3. AI Tools, Automation & Rapid Development



- Use AI-powered tools to build websites, landing pages, and funnels significantly faster.

- Create automations to streamline e-commerce operations.

- Work with tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Make, n8n, Zapier, or equivalent platforms.

- Build integrations between Shopify, CRM systems, advertising platforms, and other business tools.

- Develop custom dashboards and internal business applications.

- Automate repetitive tasks and operational workflows.

- Use AI-assisted coding and development tools to accelerate execution.

- Identify opportunities to replace manual processes with reliable automations.



We want someone who genuinely knows how to leverage AI to execute projects much faster, not someone who simply uses ChatGPT to generate text.



### 4. Meta Business Manager & Google Ads



The candidate must have strong knowledge of digital advertising platforms, particularly:



Meta Business Manager / Meta Ads



- Manage Meta Business Manager and advertising accounts.

- Configure Meta Pixel and Conversions API (CAPI).

- Set up events, domain verification, and conversion tracking.

- Create, configure, and manage advertising campaigns.

- Understand Sales, retargeting, and prospecting campaigns.

- Analyze advertising performance and campaign metrics.

- Troubleshoot tracking issues, account problems, and integration errors.



Google Ads



- Set up and manage Google Ads accounts.

- Understand Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns.

- Configure and manage Google Merchant Center.

- Implement conversion tracking.

- Integrate Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager.

- Analyze ROAS, CPA, CPC, and other performance metrics.

- Identify tracking issues and optimization opportunities.



We are not necessarily looking for a dedicated media buyer. We need an e-commerce expert who understands advertising platforms, can work with campaigns independently, and can correctly manage all technical integrations and tracking systems.



### 5.
 Marketing & Customer Retention



- Build automated
 marketing campaigns and flows.

- Set up abandoned cart and abandoned checkout recovery sequences.

- Create post-purchase
 automations.

- Implement upsell and cross-sell
 campaigns.

- Build customer segmentation and retention workflows.

- Work with Klaviyo, Shopify
, or similar platforms.



### 6. Analytics, Profit & Loss Dashboards



- Build custom dashboards to monitor e-commerce performance.

- Integrate data from Shopify, Meta Ads, and Google Ads.

- Track revenue, advertising expenses, product costs, and shipping costs.

- Calculate profit margins, ROAS, CPA, and overall profitability.

- Create automated reporting systems.

- Monitor inventory levels and product availability.

- Develop internal tools to improve business decision-making.



### 7. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)



- Analyze and improve website conversion rates.

- Optimize product pages, landing pages, and checkout experiences.

- Identify friction points and drop-offs throughout the sales funnel.

- Implement A/B testing.

- Improve Average Order Value (AOV), conversion rate, and revenue per visitor.

- Proactively suggest improvements based on performance data.



## 🎯 Essential Requirements



- Extensive, proven experience in the e-commerce industry.

- Expert-level Shopify knowledge.

- Hands-on experience with Funnelish and/or Checkout Champ, ideally both.

- Strong experience building advanced sales funnels and post-purchase offers.

- Excellent knowledge of Meta Business Manager and Google Ads.

- Ability to configure pixels, conversion events, tracking systems, and integrations.

- Strong experience with AI development tools and automation platforms.

- Knowledge of
 marketing and customer retention systems.

- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

- Excellent technical problem-solving skills.

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Strong communication skills and reliable availability.

- Extremely fast execution without sacrificing quality.



We care much more about real-world skills, completed projects, measurable results, and execution speed than degrees or certifications.



## 🔥 The Ideal Candidate



We do not want someone who needs step-by-step instructions for every task.



We are looking for someone who can receive an objective and independently:



- Identify the best technical solution.

- Select the most effective tools.

- Build and implement the project quickly.

- Test everything thoroughly.

- Deliver complete, professional, and functional results.

- Proactively recommend improvements to increase performance.



Our goal is to hire a highly specialized Senior E-commerce Web Developer who becomes the main technical and operational expert for our entire e-commerce ecosystem.



## 📩 How to Apply



To be considered, you must answer ALL the following questions



1. E-commerce Experience



How many years have you worked in e-commerce? Which brands or companies have you worked with?



2. Shopify Expertise



Rate your Shopify skills from 1 to 10. Share at least 2–3 Shopify stores or pages you personally developed.



3. Funnelish & Checkout Champ



Have you worked with Funnelish or Checkout Champ? Which platform do you know best? Share real examples of funnels you have built.



4. Post-Purchase Funnels



Do you have experience creating upsells, downsells, order bumps, and one-click post-purchase offers? Which tools have you used?



5. Meta Business Manager



What is your experience level with Meta Business Manager? Can you configure Meta Pixel, Conversions API, events, and advertising campaigns?



6. Google Ads



Do you have experience with Google Ads, Merchant Center, GA4, and Google Tag Manager? Have you configured or managed Search, Shopping, or Performance Max campaigns?



7. Artificial Intelligence



Which AI tools do you use daily? Share specific examples of websites, automations, dashboards, or applications you have built using AI.



8.
 Marketing



Which
 marketing platforms have you worked with? Have you built automated flows for abandoned checkouts, post-purchase sequences, and customer retention?



9. Profit & Loss Dashboards



Have you ever built a dashboard that automatically calculates e-commerce revenue, advertising expenses, operational costs, and net profit?



10. Execution Speed



How long would it realistically take you to:



- Build a complete Shopify landing page?

- Create a sales funnel with checkout, upsells, and downsells?

- Set up a post-purchase funnel?

- Build a fully functional Shopify store?

- Create a P&L dashboard integrated with Shopify and Meta Ads?



11. Availability



How many hours per day and days per week are you available? Can you start immediately?



12. Skills Self-Assessment



Rate your skills from 1 to 10 in each of the following areas:



- Shopify

- Funnelish

- Checkout Champ

- Landing Pages & CRO

- Meta Business Manager

- Google Ads

- AI Website Building

- AI Automation

-
 Marketing

- Analytics & P&L Dashboards



13. Compensation



What is your expected monthly salary in USD for a full-time position?



14. Why Should We Hire You?



Explain what makes you more skilled, faster, and more effective than other candidates. Provide concrete examples of your work and achievements.



## ⚠️ Important



**This position is strictly for professionals with advanced, proven e-commerce experience.**



We are not looking for beginners, generic web developers, or people who only understand the basic features of Shopify.



We have multiple ongoing projects and are looking for a long-term team member who can take ownership of technical projects, work independently, and directly contribute to our company's growth.



**Please do not submit generic or entirely AI-generated applications without real examples of your work.**



We want to see actual portfolios, working projects, demonstrable technical expertise, and realistic delivery times.



**If you are a true e-commerce expert, have advanced Shopify and funnel-building skills, know how to leverage AI, understand Meta and Google advertising platforms, and can execute extremely quickly, we want to hear from you.**

description:
# SEO & Link Building Specialist – Outreach & Digital PR



## About Us



We are a fast-growing digital health company building and growing consumer health brands. We're looking for an experienced, hands-on SEO specialist who enjoys finding opportunities, improving organic visibility, building quality backlinks, and connecting with websites, publishers, creators, and partners.



This is an execution-focused role for someone who understands SEO and knows how to turn research into measurable results — not someone who only runs reports or sends generic outreach
s.



## Work Schedule & Compensation



- **Location:** Remote – Philippines

- **Schedule:** Monday to Friday, typically **2:00 PM–12:00 AM Philippine Time**

- **Compensation:** Approximately **$1,100 USD per month based on working the full schedule**

- **Payment:** Paid twice per month via Wise

- **Time Off:** 12 paid days off per year

## Role Overview



You'll help grow our organic search presence, search rankings, and online authority across multiple consumer health brands.



Your work will include hands-on SEO optimization, keyword and competitor research, quality backlink acquisition, guest-post outreach, reputation monitoring, digital PR opportunities, and identifying new websites, communities, creators, and partnerships that can help grow our brands.



You'll work closely with our content team and marketing supervisor, helping turn SEO research and opportunities into actual improvements.



We're especially interested in someone who can independently identify opportunities, take action, and follow through until results are achieved.



## Key Responsibilities



- Perform on-page SEO improvements across existing website content, including titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal links, and content optimization

- Research keywords, search trends, competitors, and new organic growth opportunities

- Identify pages that should be updated, expanded, or better optimized to improve rankings

- Analyze competitor backlink profiles and identify realistic link-building opportunities

- Find and secure quality backlinks, relevant guest posts, and editorial placements

- Conduct personalized outreach to relevant websites, publishers, newsletters, and partners

- Monitor backlinks, brand mentions, lost links, and opportunities for link reclamation

- Identify digital PR, expert contribution, and content promotion opportunities

- Monitor reviews, Reddit, forums, and other online conversations around our brands and industry

- Help manage citations, profiles, directories, and other offsite brand assets

- Research potential influencers, affiliates, creators, and partnership opportunities

- Maintain organized outreach pipelines, follow-ups, and placement records

- Track SEO improvements, outreach performance, and acquired backlinks

- Use AI and modern SEO tools to research faster, identify opportunities, and improve the quality of your work



## Requirements



- **At least 2 years of hands-on SEO experience**, ideally involving both on-page SEO and link building

- Proven experience conducting outreach and acquiring quality backlinks or guest-post placements

- Good understanding of keyword research, competitor analysis, and on-page/off-page SEO

- Ability to evaluate backlink quality and relevance rather than focusing only on link quantity

- Strong research skills and attention to detail

- Strong written English and professional outreach communication skills

- Comfortable reaching out to websites, publishers, creators, and potential partners

- Able to stay organized while managing multiple opportunities, campaigns, and follow-ups

- Comfortable working independently, taking initiative, and owning results

- Interested in learning and testing new SEO and digital marketing strategies

- Comfortable using AI tools as part of your everyday workflow



## Experience That Is a Plus



Experience with any of the following is helpful, but you do not need to know everything:



- Google Search Console

- Ahrefs or Semrush

- WordPress

- Google Analytics

- Link-building and outreach tools

- Reddit and online community research

- Guest posting, editorial outreach, or digital PR

- Influencer or affiliate outreach

- Local SEO and citation management

- SEO experience with healthcare, wellness, or other competitive consumer industries



## Who We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who is naturally curious, resourceful, and results-oriented.



You should be the type of person who can look at a website, search result, competitor, backlink profile, or online conversation and immediately start identifying opportunities.



We value people who take initiative, communicate clearly, stay organized, and continually look for smarter ways to improve results.



**Most importantly, we're looking for someone who can execute.** Someone who doesn't just identify opportunities but actively pursues them, follows up, and helps deliver meaningful SEO improvements.



## How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:



1. A brief overview of your SEO and link-building experience. A

2. **Two or three examples of backlinks, guest posts, or outreach placements you've helped secure**, including the websites if available.

3. The SEO tools you regularly use and what you use them for.

4. A short video introduction with an explanation of how you determine whether a website is worth pursuing for a backlink. This way we can gauge your communication

title: Part-Time Three.js / Full-Stack Web Developer — Interactive Science Education Platform
description:
Company: Kiku Learning

Location: Remote — Philippines

Schedule: Part-time, flexible, approximately 6–12 hours per week initially

Compensation: $10–$18 USD/hour, depending on demonstrated experience

Engagement: Ongoing, as-needed project work with potential for increased hours



About Kiku Learning



Kiku Learning is a developing online science and healthcare education platform designed to make challenging subjects easier to understand through interactive learning, realistic 3D laboratories, clinical scenarios, visual explanations, and meaningful connections between scientific concepts.



Our goal is to create an academically rigorous but engaging learning experience for students pursuing nursing, medicine, allied health, and other science-related fields.



The platform is already under active development. We are not starting from scratch.



We currently have an established website with course content, learning units, interactive educational features, and several working 3D laboratory prototypes. Our existing work includes:



Mount Kiku, an interactive 3D mountain expedition that connects calculus, slopes, derivatives, elevation, weather, and optimization.



Evolution Island, an ecosystem and evolutionary biology simulation.



A 3D nephron learning experience.



An interactive human heart anatomy viewer with external and cross-sectional models.



Additional anatomy, pharmacology, clinical education, and student learning tools.



Our development workflow currently uses AI-assisted coding, GitHub, Cloudflare, and Three.js.



We are seeking a skilled developer who can take ownership of the technical implementation, improve the quality of existing features, and help us expand our interactive learning experiences.



Responsibilities



Review and understand our existing codebase and website architecture.



Improve and maintain existing functionality without unnecessary redesigns.



Integrate professional 3D models, animations, and interactive environments into the website.



Work with Three.js, WebGL, GLB/glTF files, textures, lighting, and shaders.



Improve realistic movement, camera controls, navigation, and student interaction in 3D labs.



Optimize website and 3D performance for desktop, tablets, and mobile devices.



Troubleshoot technical issues and implement well-tested fixes.



Collaborate with a 3D artist to integrate custom assets.



Maintain clean, documented code and safe GitHub development workflows.



Test changes in staging before production deployment.



Help translate educational concepts into engaging, functional simulations.



Required Qualifications



Demonstrable experience with JavaScript and modern web development.



Experience with Three.js, React Three Fiber, Babylon.js, or comparable browser-based 3D technology; direct Three.js experience strongly preferred.



Ability to work with GitHub and existing codebases.



Understanding of 3D model loading, optimization, lighting, and rendering.



Experience with responsive websites and performance optimization.



Strong problem-solving ability and clear English communication.



Ability to work independently and explain technical decisions to a nontechnical founder.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience with Blender and 3D asset pipelines.



Experience with Cloudflare deployment.



Experience creating interactive educational tools, simulations, games, or scientific visualizations.



Familiarity with physics-based interactions, mathematical visualization, or animation.



Experience collaborating with AI-assisted development workflows.



What We're Looking For



We want someone who is creative, technically capable, reliable, and genuinely interested in building meaningful educational technology.



You do not need to be a medical professional or a science educator. Scientific content and anatomy will undergo separate subject-matter review.



We value thoughtful solutions, honest communication, and preserving the work that is already functioning.



How to Apply



Please submit:



Your resume and portfolio or GitHub profile.



Links to two or three interactive websites, 3D applications, or simulations you personally developed.



A brief explanation of your experience with Three.js or similar technology.



Your hourly rate and weekly availability.



Your experience with existing codebases and AI-assisted development tools.



Application question: How would you improve the visual realism and free movement of an existing Three.js mountain simulation without breaking its current mathematics and learning features?



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a small, paid technical assessment.



We look forward to meeting developers who want to help build the next generation of interactive science education.

Long-Term Growth & Career Opportunities



Kiku Learning is an early-stage educational technology company with ambitious plans for growth. Our vision extends beyond creating a traditional learning website. We are developing a comprehensive, interactive science and healthcare education platform designed to serve students across multiple disciplines and potentially around the world.



Although this position will begin as part-time, flexible, and project-based, we are looking for individuals who may be interested in growing with the company long-term.



As Kiku Learning develops, expands its curriculum, launches additional interactive laboratories, and grows its subscriber base, there may be opportunities for:



Transitioning into a full-time position with a more structured schedule and established compensation.



Increased hourly compensation based on responsibilities, performance, company growth, and available funding.



Advancement into senior, lead, or management roles as the technical and creative teams expand.



Taking ownership of larger projects, new learning experiences, and future platform developments.



Becoming a long-term member of Kiku Learning's core development team.



We value creativity, initiative, technical excellence, collaboration, and a genuine commitment to making science education more accessible and engaging.



Our goal is to build a team where talented individuals have the opportunity to contribute meaningfully, develop professionally, and grow alongside the company.



Please note: Future full-time employment, promotions, and compensation increases are potential opportunities rather than guaranteed commitments. They will depend on business performance, funding, individual contributions, and organizational needs.

title: UGC Video Editor (Part-Time, Daily Work)
description:
I'm looking for a reliable, creative, detail-oriented video editor to edit short-form UGC (User Generated Content) videos for my brand campaigns. The work is mostly talking-head videos: clean cuts, engaging pacing, captions, and text overlays. You'll take raw footage and turn it into polished content that's ready for brand approval.



This is DAILY work. I'm currently running three campaigns: one is batched, and the other two need videos edited each day as they come in. It starts at around 4-5 hours a week, and as the campaigns grow and brands want more videos per day, there will be more hours and more work for the right person.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Edit short-form UGC videos, mainly talking-head content

- Cut unnecessary pauses, silences, mistakes, and awkward transitions

- Add clean, easy-to-read, properly timed captions/subtitles

- Add text overlays, hooks, and key phrases when instructed

- Keep the pacing tight so viewers keep watching

- Follow my editing instructions, references, and brand guidelines

- Export videos in the correct format and resolution for each campaign

- Make revisions based on feedback from me or the brand

- Organize completed edits and project files in Google Drive and Notion



EDITING STYLE

The editing itself is simple. I'm looking for:

- Clean, natural-looking edits (not overly edited)

- Good pacing without unnecessary gaps or silences

- Easy-to-read captions

- Simple text overlays and hooks

- Consistent formatting across video variations

- An understanding of short-form content and what keeps viewers watching



You don't need to be an advanced editor. Following instructions, paying attention to detail, and delivering consistent daily work matter more.



WORKFLOW & COMMUNICATION

We'll work through Notion and Google Drive. I'll use Notion to assign editing tasks, give instructions, track deadlines, and share feedback, and Google Drive to share raw footage, editing references, and completed videos. Every video is submitted to me for review and approval before it's final. Communication should be clear, timely, and professional, and you should be comfortable working independently and managing your deadlines.



EXPECTATIONS

- Reliable, consistent daily delivery

- Ability to follow instructions and meet deadlines

- Attention to detail, especially captions, spelling, and timing

- Openness to feedback and revisions

- Letting me know early if a deadline can't be met

- Respect for confidentiality of unreleased brand campaign materials



IMPORTANT: I only review applicants who follow this step. If you're genuinely interested, send a DM

REQUIREMENTS

- Previous experience editing short-form videos (Reels, TikToks, UGC, etc.)

- Good written English for accurate captions and overlays

- Stable internet connection and comfortable using Google Drive

- A computer or device that can handle video files

COMPENSATION & HOURS

title: Part-Time 3D Artist / Blender Generalist — Realistic Science, Anatomy & Simulation Assets
description:
Company: Kiku Learning

Location: Remote — Philippines

Schedule: Flexible, part-time or project-based, approximately 5–10 hours per week when projects are active

Compensation: $8–$15 USD/hour initially, negotiable based on portfolio and specialized experience

Engagement: As-needed projects with opportunities for ongoing collaboration



About Kiku Learning



Kiku Learning is an emerging science and healthcare education platform combining comprehensive academic lessons with interactive 3D laboratories, realistic scientific environments, and clinical learning experiences.



We are building an educational platform where students can explore scientific concepts rather than simply read about them.



Our existing projects include:



Mount Kiku: a realistic mountain expedition used to teach calculus, gradients, optimization, and scientific reasoning.



Evolution Island: an interactive ecosystem and evolution experience.



A 3D nephron simulation for renal anatomy and physiology.



An interactive human heart anatomy viewer.



Planned operating-room simulations, surgical anatomy environments, and additional science laboratories.



We already have an operational development workflow and working prototypes. We are seeking an artist to help elevate the visual realism, asset quality, and animation of these experiences.



Responsibilities



3D Modeling and Environment Design



Create realistic 3D models, environments, props, and scientific visualizations.



Develop detailed mountains, rocks, snow, ice, terrain, and expedition equipment.



Create realistic operating-room environments, hospital equipment, surgical instruments, and medical props.



Build or adapt anatomical models using provided scientific references.



Produce realistic materials, textures, lighting setups, and environmental details.



Rigging and Animation



Rig and animate characters, wildlife, and interactive objects.



Develop natural movement and realistic animation sequences.



Prepare assets for use in interactive simulations.



Collaborate with our developer on animation and model integration.



Technical Asset Preparation



Work primarily in Blender or comparable professional 3D software.



Export models in GLB/glTF and other suitable formats.



Optimize polygon counts, texture sizes, UV maps, and materials for browser performance.



Create PBR textures and organized model hierarchies.



Prepare clean, editable source files and document asset specifications.



Modify licensed third-party assets when their terms permit it.



Scientific and Educational Quality



Follow supplied anatomical, scientific, and technical references.



Identify when an anatomical or scientific detail requires expert verification.



Avoid inventing anatomical structures or presenting visually attractive but inaccurate models as scientifically validated.



Work collaboratively with developers and subject-matter reviewers.



Required Qualifications



Strong portfolio of professional 3D modeling work.



Proficiency in Blender.



Experience with realistic texturing, UV mapping, lighting, and PBR materials.



Experience optimizing 3D models for real-time applications.



Ability to export and troubleshoot GLB/glTF assets.



Strong communication and ability to follow visual references.



Willingness to work on existing projects rather than requiring a complete redesign.



Highly Preferred Qualifications



Experience with medical or anatomical visualization.



Experience with realistic terrain and environment creation.



Character rigging and animation.



Experience with Three.js or WebGL asset workflows.



Experience with procedural modeling, photogrammetry, sculpting, or ZBrush.



Experience with interactive simulations, game development, or educational applications.



Experience in every category is not required. Please clearly identify your strongest specialties.



What Success Looks Like



We want 3D experiences that feel professional, realistic, and immersive without sacrificing educational accuracy or website performance.



For medical anatomy, visual accuracy must be evaluated against credible references and approved by appropriate subject-matter reviewers before educational publication.



We value originality, attention to detail, technical discipline, and a collaborative approach.



How to Apply



Please provide:



Your portfolio, ArtStation, Sketchfab, or comparable work samples.



Examples of realistic environments, anatomical models, rigged characters, or interactive assets.



Your experience preparing models for browser-based applications.



Your hourly rate and availability.



Your preferred 3D software and export formats.



Whether you have previously worked on scientific, medical, or educational visualizations.



Application question: How would you create a realistic, browser-optimized human heart or snowy mountain environment for an interactive science education platform, and what would you do to ensure the final model is accurate and performs well?



Shortlisted applicants may be offered a small, paid practical assignment.



We are excited to collaborate with artists who enjoy combining technical skill, creativity, and education.

### Long-Term Growth & Career Opportunities



Kiku Learning is an early-stage educational technology company with ambitious plans for growth. Our vision extends beyond creating a traditional learning website. We are developing a comprehensive, interactive science and healthcare education platform designed to serve students across multiple disciplines and potentially around the world.



Although this position will begin as part-time, flexible, and project-based, **we are looking for individuals who may be interested in growing with the company long-term.**



As Kiku Learning develops, expands its curriculum, launches additional interactive laboratories, and grows its subscriber base, there may be opportunities for:



- Transitioning into a full-time position with a more structured schedule and established compensation.

- Increased hourly compensation based on responsibilities, performance, company growth, and available funding.

- Advancement into senior, lead, or management roles as the technical and creative teams expand.

- Taking ownership of larger projects, new learning experiences, and future platform developments.

- Becoming a long-term member of Kiku Learning's core development team.



We value creativity, initiative, technical excellence, collaboration, and a genuine commitment to making science education more accessible and engaging.



Our goal is to build a team where talented individuals have the opportunity to contribute meaningfully, develop professionally, and grow alongside the company.



**Please note:** Future full-time employment, promotions, and compensation increases are potential opportunities rather than guaranteed commitments. They will depend on business performance, funding, individual contributions, and organizational needs.

title: Business Development & Lead Generation Virtual Assistant – Cleaning Company
description:
About Us



Tampa Tide Home Services is a growing cleaning company based in Tampa, Florida, USA. We specialize in residential cleaning, deep cleaning, move-in/move-out cleaning, rental property turnovers, and commercial cleaning.



We are looking for a motivated, reliable, and proactive Virtual Assistant to help us generate new business, book cleaning jobs, and establish long-term relationships with companies that need cleaning services.



This is a long-term opportunity with room for growth and performance-based bonuses.



Primary Responsibilities



Lead Generation & Immediate Job Opportunities



* Find individuals and businesses actively looking for cleaning services.

* Monitor relevant
 groups, community platforms, and online job opportunities for cleaning requests.

* Identify landlords, real estate agents, property managers, and investors who need properties cleaned.

* Contact potential customers through
, phone calls, and approved social media accounts.

* Follow up with interested customers and help convert leads into booked cleaning jobs.

* Identify urgent, same-day, and upcoming cleaning opportunities.



Vendor Applications & Business Development



* Research property management companies, apartment communities, and real estate investment companies.

* Find vendor registration portals and vendor application requirements.

* Complete vendor applications using company-provided information and documents.

* Contact decision-makers responsible for hiring cleaning companies.

* Follow up regularly on submitted vendor applications.

* Build relationships with businesses that can provide recurring cleaning work.



Commercial Cleaning Outreach



* Contact medical and dental offices, daycares, gyms, churches, professional offices, salons, and other local businesses.

* Identify businesses looking for new or additional cleaning contractors.

* Schedule calls, walkthroughs, and cleaning estimates.



Administrative Responsibilities



* Maintain an organized spreadsheet of prospects, leads, applications, and follow-ups.

* Track booked jobs, new customers, and vendor approvals.

* Provide daily reports detailing completed work, responses, and upcoming opportunities.

* Assist with scheduling and customer communication as needed.



Requirements



* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Strong communication and organizational skills.

* Experience with lead generation, cold calling, appointment setting, or business development preferred.

* Comfortable making outbound calls to US businesses.

* Familiarity with Google Sheets, Gmail, and online research.

* Ability to work independently and take initiative.

* Reliable computer, internet connection, and headset.

* Availability during US Eastern Time business hours.



Compensation



* Competitive base pay depending on experience.

* $20 USD performance bonus for each qualified new customer you personally bring in who completes and pays for their first cleaning job.

* Opportunities for raises and additional responsibilities based on performance.

* Full-time, long-term opportunity following a successful paid trial period.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A brief introduction about yourself.

2. Your experience with lead generation, cold calling, or appointment setting.

3. Your experience completing applications or researching businesses.

4. How you would find immediate cleaning jobs for a cleaning company in Tampa, Florida.

5. Your availability during US Eastern Time business hours.

6. Your desired monthly salary.

7. A short voice recording introducing yourself.



Please begin your application with the words “TAMPA TIDE” so we know you have read the entire job description.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with our company and contribute directly to its success.

title: Graphic Designer - Adobe Illustrator & Large-Format Print Production
description:
Working Hours & Availability

Flexible Working Hours | Toronto Business Hours 



We’re looking for an intermediate designer who is strong in Illustrator, with experience in print production, cut contours, signage, and ideally vehicle wraps and tiling.



Communication

We care about quality, reliability, and meeting deadlines — not how many hours you spend sitting at your computer.



Flexible production hours: You can complete your design work on your own schedule, provided all assigned deadlines are met.

Communication availability: You must be reachable and responsive to our team between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM Toronto time, Monday to Friday. This does not mean you need to be actively designing throughout those hours.



Rush requests: We operate in the live events industry, so occasional urgent design requests, revisions, and last-minute changes may arise during evenings and weekends.



Weekend flexibility: You must be willing to accommodate occasional time-sensitive weekend requests, with response expectations and compensation arrangements agreed upon in advance.



Turnaround times: Standard photo booth templates generally have short production times. Larger projects, such as vehicle wraps and trailer graphics, will have longer agreed deadlines.



This is a long-term remote position supporting two established Canadian businesses. We’re looking for someone who can manage their own time, communicate proactively, and consistently deliver accurate, print-ready artwork.



Immediate Start

We’re hiring immediately. Our outgoing designer is available to provide training and a structured handover, so we’re prioritizing candidates who can start next week.

title: HIRING: Experienced Faceless YouTube Creators | Multiple Niches | $8 Per Video + View Bonuses | Long-Term Opportunity
description:
We're looking for experienced, independent Faceless YouTube Creators to join our growing team!



We own and operate multiple YouTube channels, most of which are already monetized. We're looking for talented creators who understand how to produce high-quality faceless YouTube videos that actually generate views.



Ideally, we're looking for someone who can handle the ENTIRE video production process independently — from scriptwriting to voice-over, editing, and thumbnails.



We want someone who understands YouTube, knows what makes videos successful, and can work independently without needing constant instructions.



This is a long-term opportunity with performance-based bonuses and the potential to grow alongside our channels.



Our YouTube Niches



We currently operate channels in the following niches:



🏎️ Formula 1 (F1)



🏆 Sports



🔪 True Crime / Murder Mysteries



🌊 Ocean & Marine Life



When applying, please tell us which niche you prefer working in and why.



You can choose multiple niches, but please mention your first choice.



What We're Looking For



Ideally, you can handle the complete faceless YouTube production process independently.



This includes:



Scriptwriting: Researching topics and writing engaging scripts with strong hooks, storytelling, and audience retention in mind.



Voice-over: Recording your own natural, high-quality English voice-over, preferably with an American or British accent.



Video Editing: Creating professional faceless YouTube videos with engaging visuals, excellent pacing, smooth transitions, and sound effects.



Visual Sourcing: Finding relevant footage, images, and other visuals that can legally be used in monetized YouTube videos.



Thumbnail Creation: Designing attractive, clickable thumbnails that help improve CTR.



YouTube Optimization: Understanding audience retention, watch time, CTR, and what makes YouTube videos successful.



Independent Workflow: Managing the production process from start to finish with minimal supervision.



Our ideal candidate can take a video idea and turn it into a complete, publication-ready YouTube video.



We value people who take initiative, solve problems independently, and genuinely understand how successful faceless YouTube channels operate.



EXPERIENCE & PROVEN RESULTS ARE EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



We are specifically looking for people with real experience creating faceless YouTube content.



We don't just want to hear that you're experienced. We want to SEE proof.



Anyone can claim to have worked on successful YouTube channels. That's why we require actual evidence of your previous work and results.



What Proof Do We Require?



Please provide screenshots showing results from YouTube channels you've previously worked on.



Examples include:



Screenshots from YouTube Studio showing video views and performance.



Screenshots showing channel growth or subscriber growth.



Screenshots showing revenue or monetization results.



Screenshots showing CTR, audience retention, or watch time.



Other verifiable evidence demonstrating the results of your work.



You are absolutely allowed to blur or hide the channel name and any sensitive information.



We respect your privacy and confidentiality.



However, screenshots must be genuine, and you must be able to explain exactly what you contributed to those results.



We may request additional verification during the selection process to confirm your experience.



Applications with actual proof of experience and results will receive priority.



We're much more interested in what you've actually achieved than in how many years you claim to have been working.



IMPORTANT: Can't Do Everything? STILL APPLY!



Although we prefer someone who can handle the complete production process, you do NOT need to be perfect at everything to apply.



For example:



Are you an exceptional video editor but can't record your own voice-over? APPLY!



Are you great at scriptwriting and storytelling but don't create thumbnails? APPLY!



Are you excellent at voice-overs but don't edit videos? APPLY!



Are you highly experienced with faceless YouTube channels but specialize in only certain parts of production? APPLY!



We have multiple channels and different production needs.



If you're exceptionally good at something and can prove your results, we definitely want to hear from you.



Just be honest about what you can and cannot do.



We value proven skills and results much more than someone claiming to be an expert at everything.



Long-Term Opportunity & Payment



Base payment: $8 per video + performance-based bonuses!



We are looking for people who want to build something long-term.



Our starting rate is $8 per completed video, with additional bonuses when videos reach certain view milestones.



The better your videos perform, the more you can earn!



Most of our YouTube channels are already monetized, and our goal is to grow them significantly.



We understand that the starting rate is low, but we offer the opportunity to grow alongside our channels.



What we offer:



$8 base payment per completed video



Extra bonuses when videos reach specific view milestones



Potential for higher rates as channels grow



Consistent, long-term work across multiple channels



Opportunities to take on more responsibility and earn more



Bonus milestones and rewards will be discussed and agreed upon before starting.



We believe in rewarding results. If your videos consistently generate strong views and help our channels grow, we want to reward that success.



When our channels grow, we want YOU to grow with us.



We're not looking for someone who just completes tasks. We're looking for someone who wants to help build successful YouTube channels and share in that success.



We Value Independent Creators



One of the most important things we're looking for is INDEPENDENCE.



We don't want to explain every small detail or constantly supervise the production process.



We want someone who:



Understands what makes a successful YouTube video.



Can research topics and come up with creative ideas.



Can make decisions independently.



Takes responsibility for the quality of their work.



Understands the importance of deadlines and consistency.



Knows how to create content that keeps viewers watching.



Actively looks for ways to improve video performance.



Communicates clearly and reliably.



The less supervision you need while consistently delivering excellent results, the better.



We want to build a team of people who genuinely understand YouTube and take ownership of their work.



How to Apply — PLEASE READ CAREFULLY



To be considered, please answer the following questions.



1. Which niche do you prefer?



Choose your preferred channel:



Formula 1 (F1)



Sports



True Crime / Murder Mysteries



Ocean & Marine Life



You may select multiple niches, but please tell us your first choice and why.



2. What can you do independently?



Tell us which parts of the production process you can handle:



Research and scriptwriting



Human voice-over



Video editing



Footage and visual sourcing



Thumbnail creation



Complete video production



Be honest. You don't need to be able to do everything.



3. What experience do you have with faceless YouTube channels?



Explain which channels you've worked on, what your responsibilities were, and what results you achieved.



Have you previously worked on monetized YouTube channels?



4. PROVIDE SCREENSHOTS OF YOUR RESULTS (VERY IMPORTANT)



This is one of the most important parts of your application.



Attach screenshots from YouTube Studio or other credible evidence showing the actual performance of channels or videos you've worked on.



We are especially interested in:



Video views



Channel growth



Audience retention



CTR



Revenue or monetization performance



You may blur channel names and sensitive details.



We understand that some creators work under confidentiality agreements.



However, we want genuine proof that you have experience and know how to create videos that perform.



We want proof, not just claims.



5. Show us your previous work.



Provide links to at least 2–3 videos you've personally created, edited, scripted, or voiced.



Clearly explain your role in each video.



6. Can you record your own English voice-over?



If yes, please include a sample of your natural speaking voice.



If not, that's completely fine. Just tell us.



7. Are you comfortable with our payment structure?



Our starting payment is $8 per video + performance-based bonuses when videos reach certain view milestones.



Please confirm whether you're comfortable with this structure and explain which parts of the production process you can handle for this rate.



8. How do you handle copyright and footage sourcing?



Explain how you find footage and visuals that can legally be used in monetized YouTube videos.



This is especially important for our F1, sports, and true crime channels.



We want to understand how you avoid copyright claims, strikes, and monetization problems.



9. Why should we choose you?



Tell us what makes you different, what results you've achieved, and how you could help our channels grow.



10. Do you have experience with VidRush?



Please let us know whether you have previously worked with VidRush.



If yes, briefly explain how you've used it and what your experience has been.



Experience with VidRush is a plus, but it's not required.



One Last Thing



We care about 3 things above everything else:



1. Proven experience.



2. Real, verifiable results.



3. The ability to work independently and deliver quality.



You don't need to be the best at every part of YouTube production.



But you do need to be genuinely good at what you do, and ideally, you should be able to prove it.



We're serious about growing our channels, and we're looking for equally serious people who want to become part of that journey.



If you're a talented video editor, scriptwriter, voice-over artist, or complete faceless YouTube creator, we encourage you to apply — even if you don't meet every single requirement.



We have multiple channels, long-term ambitions, and opportunities for the right people.



The better our videos perform, the more opportunities there will be for you to earn and grow.



We're looking for a long-term partnership, not just someone to complete a few videos.



If you're experienced, reliable, independent, and motivated to grow with us, we'd love to hear from you!



Let's build successful YouTube channels together!

title: Senior AI & Automation Systems Engineer
description:
PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING.  SPAM APPLICATIONS WILL BE IGNORED.



Job Title:  Senior AI & Automation Systems Engineer (Full-Stack Data, Workflows & Browser Agents)



Role Type: Full-Time / Contract-to-Hire (Remote)



About the Role



We are building an end-to-end automated job discovery, AI resume tailoring, and autonomous application platform. We are looking for a Senior AI & Automation Systems Engineer to own, architect, and build out our core 6-phase technical pipeline from the ground up.



You will be responsible for connecting multi-source data ingestion feeds, designing relational and vector database architectures, orchestrating complex LLM evaluation loops, and building resilient headless browser agents capable of navigating and submitting applications across diverse Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) with human-in-the-loop fallbacks.



What You Will Build (The 6-Phase Architecture)



 Phase 1: High-Volume Job Ingestion & Normalization Pipeline



 ●Architect scheduled hourly pulls and real-time push webhooks in self-hosted n8n from 10+ job data vendors and scraping fleets (TheirStack, CoreSignal, Bright Data, Apify, JobDataAPI, LinkdAPI, PredictLeads, Crustdata, Techmap, Hirebase, Grepsr). 

 ●Write custom JavaScript normalization logic to standardize schemas and automatically detect ATS platforms. 

 ●Implement sliding-window deduplication via Upstash Redis, persist structured job data in Supabase (PostgreSQL), generate embeddings (OpenAI text-embedding-3-small + LangChain) into Qdrant Cloud, and archive raw JSON batches to Cloudflare R2 / AWS S3. 



 Phases 2 & 3: AI Resume Tailoring & ATS Scoring Engine



 ●Build iterative LLM workflows (OpenAI GPT-4o / GPT-4o-mini) that pull user profile data, tailor resumes and cover letters without hallucination, and run automated ATS match scoring loops (0–100%) until quality thresholds (≥90%) are met. 

 ●Store generated PDF/DOCX assets in Cloudflare R2 / AWS S3. 



 Phases 4 & 5: Autonomous Browser Observation & Auto-Apply



 ●Develop cloud headless browser automation using Stagehand Engine, Browserbase, and Playwright to render job application pages, inspect DOM structures, and map form fields. 

 ●Implement AI field-matching against a user knowledge base with confidence scoring (≥95%) before autonomously filling inputs, attaching tailored resumes, submitting applications, and verifying success DOM states. 



 Phase 6: Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) & Fallback Queues



 ●Build stateful pause/resume workflows (using n8n Wait nodes, RabbitMQ, and internal dashboard APIs/Appsmith) that prompt users when field confidence is low or submissions fail. 

 ●Capture user corrections to dynamically update the Supabase user knowledge base and re-trigger browser sessions, routing edge cases to a manual review queue. 



Required Skills & Technical Experience



 Workflow Orchestration & Backend Engineering:



 ●Deep hands-on experience deploying, scaling, and extending n8n (self-hosted), including complex branching, webhook handling, custom JavaScript nodes, error handling, and long-running Wait states. 

 ●Strong proficiency in Node.js / TypeScript and Python for building core APIs, data loaders, and custom microservices.



 Database Architecture & Data Engineering:



 ●PostgreSQL (Supabase): Schema design, indexing, upserts, and high-throughput transactional logging. 

 ●Vector Databases & Search: Production experience with Qdrant (or Pinecone/Weaviate), LangChain, and OpenAI embedding models for semantic job matching. 

 ●Caching, Queues & Object Storage: Experience with Redis (Upstash) for deduplication/caching, message brokers (RabbitMQ), and S3-compatible storage (Cloudflare R2 / AWS S3). 



 AI / LLM Engineering:



 ●Proven track record building deterministic, structured-output LLM pipelines using the OpenAI API. 

 ●Experience designing prompt chains with self-correction loops, strict anti-hallucination guardrails, and confidence scoring. 



 Headless Browser & Web Automation:



 ●Strong background in browser automation using Playwright, Puppeteer, Browserbase, and AI-native browser frameworks like Stagehand. 

 ●Familiarity with anti-bot evasion, proxy rotation, dynamic DOM parsing, and handling complex multi-step forms across major ATS platforms (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, etc.).



Nice-to-Have Qualifications



 ●Experience integrating with B2B data aggregators and scraping platforms (Bright Data, Apify, CoreSignal, TheirStack). 

 ●Familiarity with low-code internal tooling (e.g., Appsmith) and Notion API integrations. 

 ●Prior experience in HR-tech, recruiting platforms, or high-volume data ingestion startups.



How to Apply



Please share:



 ●Your GitHub profile, portfolio, or links to complex automation/AI systems you have architected.

 ●A brief overview of a production pipeline you built involving n8n (or similar orchestrators), vector/relational databases, or headless browser automation.

 ●Your availability and expected compensation.

        ●After you submit your resume/application, send me a message using this Subject line: "Go big or go home."  Otherwise, your application will be ignored.

title: Appointment Setter - Instagram DMs (High-Ticket Fitness)
description:
Read this before applying: this is a sales role. You will spend your day in conversations. This is not content editing, caption writing, video editing or general VA work. If that's what you're looking for, this isn't it.



ABOUT THE ROLE



Reshape Coaching helps South Asian professionals transform their bodies without giving up the food they grew up on. 15 years in the industry, 2,000+ client transformations, clients across the UK, UAE and US.



We sell 16-week and 6-month transformation programmes at £1,495–£2,495, with an ongoing coaching option after that.

We're looking for an experienced and driven appointment setter to qualify leads and book calls.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Work the Instagram inbox: reply to inbound DMs, qualify people, and book discovery calls into the founder's calendar

- Proactively open conversations with new followers and people engaging with our content

- Follow up with no-shows and conversations that went quiet

- Log every conversation and outcome in our tracker, daily.



TARGETS

You'll work to set weekly targets for booked calls, show rate and response time. Targets are agreed with you in your first week and reviewed monthly. Hit them consistently and there are bonuses on top of your normal pay.

You'll be measured on booked calls that show up, not on messages sent.



HOURS

4pm–10pm UK time, Monday to Friday, plus two flexible hours each day for outreach, follow-ups and admin. Weekend overtime is optional.

For Philippines applicants, the live window is midnight–6am from. This is a night shift and we're not going to pretend otherwise — it's reflected in what we pay. Do NOT apply if you cannot work these hours. 



That window is when our core audience is off work and on their phones, which is when the conversations happen. It isn't flexible. Please only apply if you can genuinely hold these hours long term.



PAY

Monthly base salary, plus commission on every sale closed from the calls you book. Paid monthly via Wise.

Pay is reviewed at 3 months based on performance.



WHAT YOU NEED

- Prior experience setting appointments in DMs for a high-ticket offer (£1,000+). We'll ask for the offer, the price point and your numbers.

- Written English good enough that our leads can't tell it isn't the founder writing.

- The discipline to log your data every single day without being chased

- A reliable internet connection and a backup plan for outages

- A genuine interest in doing this long term. We train properly, and we'd rather train once.



ADDITIONAL SKILLS

- Experience setting appointments specifically in health and fitness

- Familiarity with GoHighLevel, Typeform, Calendly and spreadsheets

- Experience selling to a western South Asian audience





Training and career progression are both real here. Our setter playbook is written, tested and handed to you on day one.



HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY

- Do NOT apply through this website. Do NOT
. Apply the way you'd do the job.

- DM us on 

- Your FIRST message must begin with the word 'SETTER' - Anything that doesn't gets deleted unread.

- In that first message, include:

- Your setting experience — the offer, the price point, and your monthly booked calls

- Your rate expectations and your available hours in UK time

- A link to your CV (Google Drive, Dropbox, anything — no attachments)



- Then send a SECOND message.

- A lead replies to one of our stories saying: "how much is your coaching?"

- Send us your actual next message to them. Word for word, exactly as you would send it. One message. No preamble, no "here's what I'd say" — just send the message.

- We reply to the ones who get it right within 48 hours.



CLOSING DATE: 21 November 2026 -

# Virtual Medical Receptionist & Sales Specialist (Remote | Philippines)



We are a growing chiropractic practice in the United States seeking a friendly, confident, and sales-driven Virtual Receptionist to join our team.



This position is ideal for someone who enjoys speaking with people, has excellent English communication skills, and knows how to turn phone inquiries into booked appointments.



**This is more than a traditional receptionist position. A large part of the role involves sales, so we are looking for someone who can confidently answer questions, overcome objections, and encourage prospective patients to schedule their first visit.**



### Key Responsibilities



- Answer incoming phone calls in a friendly, professional, and welcoming manner.

- Schedule, reschedule, and confirm patient appointments.

- Answer questions about chiropractic services, pricing, promotions, and appointment availability.

- Convert incoming inquiries into booked new-patient appointments.

- Confidently address concerns and objections from prospective patients.

- Follow up with missed calls and potential patients who have not yet scheduled.

- Maintain accurate patient information and appointment records.

- Provide excellent customer service to both new and existing patients.



### Qualifications



- Excellent spoken and written English with clear, easy-to-understand pronunciation.

- Previous experience in phone sales, appointment setting, customer service, or medical reception.

- Strong sales skills with the ability to confidently close appointments.

- Friendly, outgoing personality and a positive attitude.

- Comfortable handling objections and speaking with prospective patients who may be hesitant to book.

- Strong organizational and multitasking skills.

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional workspace.

- Ability to work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

- Experience with chiropractic offices, medical scheduling, or healthcare services is a plus.



### Compensation & Incentives



- Competitive hourly pay based on experience.

- **Additional performance-based incentives for successfully converted new-patient appointments.**

- Opportunity to earn more based on sales performance.

- Long-term opportunity with a growing U.S.-based healthcare practice.



### How to Apply



**IMPORTANT: Applications must include an audio recording of your voice.**



Please submit the following:



1. Your resume and relevant work experience.

2. Your desired hourly rate in USD.

3. A short audio recording (approximately 60–90 seconds) introducing yourself and explaining your experience with phone sales, customer service, or appointment scheduling.

4. In your recording, briefly demonstrate how you would respond to a potential patient who calls asking about pricing but is hesitant to schedule an appointment.



**Applications without an audio recording will not be considered.**



We are looking for someone who can make patients feel comfortable, build trust quickly, and confidently turn conversations into appointments. If you have a great phone personality and enjoy sales, we would love to hear from you!

Our system prepares most customer replies using approved templates. You are the human check: you read the conversation, compare the reply with the order details and tracking, correct errors according to our written policies, and send the right answer.

You also follow up with our fulfilment partner when orders are delayed or something goes wrong. We provide training on our systems and policies, but you should already understand the everyday customer service challenges of dropshipping.



WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY

- Check and send customer replies about orders, delivery delays, sizing, returns and address changes.

- Verify order details, tracking updates, dates and amounts before sending.

- Follow up on delayed orders and problem cases with our fulfilment partner throughDiscord

- Ask customers for photos or additional information when needed.

- Follow our written policies and flag cases that need an owner’s decision.

- Keep clear case notes and follow up until each issue is resolved.

- Make sure no customer email waits longer than 24 hours for a response.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- At least 1 year of customer support experience with Shopify dropshipping stores.

- Women’s fashion dropshipping experience is a strong advantage.

- Excellent written English.

- Experience handling shipping delays, tracking issues, sizing complaints, returns and refund requests.

- Strong attention to detail: you notice incorrect dates, amounts, products and tracking statuses.

- A calm, professional approach to upset customers.

- Ability to follow written procedures and work reliably without constant supervision.

- Stable internet, your own laptop and a quiet place to work.



SCHEDULE AND PAY

- Full time: 8 hours per day, at least 6 days per week.

- $4 USD per hour, approximately $830 per month based on 48 hours per week.

- Long-term position with training through written guides and videos.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with KIWI and answer every question below:

1. Which Shopify dropshipping stores have you worked for? Include the store names, website URLs, your role and the dates you worked there.

2. Did any of these stores sell women’s fashion? Which ones?

3. What customer support tasks did you personally handle, which tools did you use, and approximately how many tickets did you handle per day?

4. Describe one difficult customer case you personally resolved involving a delayed order, sizing complaint or return. What did you check, what action did you take, and what was the outcome?

5. Confirm that you are available for the schedule and hourly rate above. Include your time zone and earliest start date.



If a confidentiality agreement prevents you from naming a store, explain this and suggest another way to verify your experience. Please do not share customer information or confidential company records.

We will only consider applications that answer these questions and demonstrate relevant Shopify dropshipping customer support experience. Shortlisted candidates will complete a short practical assessment using fictional customer cases and our written policies.

title: Full-Time SEO / AI Search Specialist (Technical, On-Page, Content & Links) – Long-Term Role
description:
ABOUT US

We are a growing local SEO agency helping service businesses (clinics, home services and other local companies) in the US and Canada get found on Google and in AI search. We are looking for one experienced, hands-on SEO / AI search specialist to take ownership of a large part of our day-to-day SEO delivery.



This is a long-term role, not a short project. You will work directly with the founder, receive full training on our systems, and grow with the company.



---



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Research & Planning

- Keyword research for local service businesses (service + city, near-me, long-tail)

- Citation research: find the right directories and audit NAP consistency

- AI query fan-out research: map the sub-questions Google AI Overviews / AI Mode / ChatGPT generate for a topic, and plan content to cover them

- Plan AI-assisted content: page outlines, content calendars, topic clusters



Execution

- On-page SEO: titles, metas, headings, internal linking, schema, image optimization

- Technical SEO: site audits, indexing issues, speed/Core Web Vitals, crawl errors, redirects, sitemaps

- Content, end to end:

  • Research: SERP and competitor analysis, search intent, topic gaps, AI fan-out questions, facts and sources

  • Write: service pages, location pages, blog posts, FAQs and GBP posts, using AI tools to speed up, then edited by you so it is accurate, natural and on-brand (no raw AI copy-paste)

  • Optimize and publish in WordPress, and refresh existing pages that are underperforming

- Build and clean up citations

- Link building, end to end (white-hat only):

  • Prospect link opportunities: local sites, niche blogs, directories, partners, sponsorships, guest posts, unlinked mentions

  • Vet sites for quality (traffic, relevance, spam signals)

  • Run outreach, follow up and negotiate placements

  • Get links placed, check they're live and indexed, and track them in our link log

- Google Business Profile optimization and posting



---



REQUIREMENTS

- 2+ years of hands-on SEO experience (local SEO a big plus)

- Understands how AI search works (Google AI Overviews / AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity) and how to get businesses cited in it

- PORTFOLIO REQUIRED: live URLs you worked on, plus proof of results (GSC screenshots, ranking reports, GBP insights, before/after). Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.

- Comfortable with tools such as Ahrefs / Semrush / Mangools, Google Search Console, GA4, Screaming Frog, BrightLocal or Whitespark

- WordPress experience (editing pages, plugins like Rank Math / Yoast)

- Strong written English

- Uses AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) effectively and knows their limits

- Reliable internet and a backup power/internet plan

- Self-managed: you can take a task list and run with it without hand-holding



---



IMPORTANT – PLEASE READ

- This is FULL TIME and EXCLUSIVE. No outside client work or other jobs while working with us.

- You must genuinely enjoy SEO. We want someone who reads about algorithm updates for fun, not someone just looking for any VA job.

- Full training is provided on our systems, processes and tools. However, this is NOT an entry-level role. You must already have a solid foundation in on-page, technical and local SEO. We train you on how we work, not on SEO basics.

- Raises and promotion come with time and performance. As the agency grows, this role can grow into a senior / team lead position.



---



HOW TO APPLY

Send a message with:

1. The subject line: "SEO/AI – [Your Name] – Fan Out"

2. Your portfolio (live URLs + proof of results)

3. One SEO win you're proud of: what the problem was, what you did, and the result

4. In 3–5 sentences: how would you rank a new physiotherapy clinic in a mid-size city?

5. Your current tool stack



Applications that skip the subject line or the portfolio will not be considered. Shortlisted applicants will complete a short paid test task.

title: Senior Network Engineer - Carrier / Service Provider Backbone (Juniper, Remote)
description:
Senior Network Engineer - Carrier / Service Provider Backbone (Juniper)

FDC Servers (AS30058) | Fully remote | Senior (L3) | Independent contractor



ABOUT FDC SERVERS

FDC Servers (AS30058) is a global dedicated server, colocation, and IP transit provider operating our own international backbone across 27+ points of presence in North America, Europe, APAC, and LATAM, with over 100 Tbps of installed external network capacity. We run a true service-provider network: carrier peering, IP transit, DDoS mitigation, and high-throughput hosting infrastructure. We are expanding our network engineering team.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer with a genuine carrier / service provider background. You have spent years hands-on inside a Tier 1 or Tier 2 carrier, IP transit provider, or large ISP backbone, working on Juniper at scale.



This is not an enterprise networking role. If your experience is primarily corporate campus, office LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, or enterprise data center, this position is not a fit. We need engineers who have lived in a live SP production environment: full BGP tables, carrier peering, IX fabrics, MPLS/SR backbones, and maintenance windows where a mistake has real blast radius.



You will act as the L3 authority on our global backbone, owning complex routing escalations, architecture decisions, capacity planning, and mentoring our Tier 2 team, working alongside our existing US/EU engineers. This role is fully remote.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Act as the ultimate L3 escalation point for complex routing, switching, and backbone infrastructure i
 across a global carrier-grade network.

- Configure, maintain, and optimize core/aggregation/edge Juniper (QFX, PTX) routers and switches, with occasional support for Cisco platforms (IOS-XR, NX-OS).

- Architect, manage, and troubleshoot ISIS, BGP, IP/MPLS, SR-MPLS, SRv6, routing policy, and scalability at carrier scale.

- Manage transit, peering, and IX relationships at the technical level: BGP policy, communities, traffic engineering, and inbound/outbound path optimization across multiple Tier 1 carriers.

- Lead mitigation during severe network anomalies and DDoS events using BGP Flowspec, RTBH, and traffic scrubbing workflows.

- Drive capacity planning, redundancy reviews, circuit turn-ups, backbone migrations, and major Junos software upgrades.

- Validate and peer-review complex network change scripts (Juniper set-style) prior to implementation in maintenance windows.

- Mentor Tier 2 network engineers, establishing troubleshooting procedures and clear escalation boundaries.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

- Prior employment with a Tier 1 / Tier 2 carrier, IP transit provider, ISP, or large-scale hosting/data center network operator. Enterprise-only backgrounds will not be considered.

- Expert-level hands-on Juniper Junos experience in a live SP production environment (QFX/PTX class hardware).

- Deep operational command of Service Provider protocols: ISIS, BGP (full tables, peering, transit policy), IP/MPLS, SR-MPLS, SRv6, EVPN.

- Practical experience with BGP Flowspec, L3VPN/L2VPN, anycast gateways, and traffic engineering on a production backbone.

- Experience evaluating SP-grade hardware limitations: line-card vs. ASIC/SoC architectures, FIB scale, and platform selection.

- Advanced Layer 2/3 troubleshooting: packet capture analysis, deep route table analysis, log parsing under pressure.

- Strong risk-assessment mindset: you understand blast radius and customer impact before touching a production router.

- Professional written and spoken English for documentation, post-mortems, and mentoring.



PREFERRED

- JNCIP-SP or JNCIE-SP certification (or demonstrably equivalent experience).

- Network automation: Ansible, NetBox API, Python, Git.

- Cisco IOS-XR / NX-OS experience in SP or spine-and-leaf environments.

- Experience directing remote hands teams for complex deployments, fiber rollouts, and infrastructure audits.



IDEAL CANDIDATE

You came up through carrier NOCs and backbone engineering teams, not corporate IT. You take absolute ownership of network health, thrive in high-stakes maintenance windows, and can move between hands-on Junos work and architectural oversight without dropping either. You will be a reliable anchor for our Tier 2 team and a senior technical presence on our global backbone.



ENGAGEMENT

- Fully remote, long-term independent contractor engagement.

- Pay by agreement, based on experience.



ID-verified accounts only.



Note to recruiting and staffing agencies: please do not contact us regarding this posting. We work with direct candidates only.
