- CAPCUT PRO: You currently have your own active, paid CapCut Pro subscription.

- CANVA PRO: You currently have your own active, paid Canva Pro subscription.

- ADVANCED EDITING: You are proficient in cinematic speed ramping, keyframe animation, masking, motion graphics, sophisticated transitions, color grading, audio synchronization, and refined typography.

- LUXURY PORTFOLIO: You have existing, personally edited videos demonstrating cinematic quality comparable to the references below.

- INDEPENDENT TOOLS: You already possess the required software, subscriptions, computer equipment, and reliable internet. The Royal Cup does not provide software subscriptions.

- COMPENSATION: You accept $5 USD per hour, up to seven authorized hours weekly, with a maximum initial budget of $35 per week.

- RELIABILITY: You can work independently, follow established brand guidelines, communicate professionally, and meet agreed deadlines.



IMPORTANT: Free software versions, promises to upgrade after hiring, or intentions to learn advanced techniques do not satisfy these requirements.



Additional software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve Studio is welcome but does not replace CapCut Pro and Canva Pro.



If you meet every qualification above, continue reading. Your understanding of this posting will be part of our screening process.



----------------------------------------



CREATIVE REFERENCES — REQUIRED VIEWING



The Royal Cup is a luxury private bartending experience. Our content must sell the EXPERIENCE, not simply advertise a product.



Review ALL FOUR references before applying.



01 — BRAND IDENTITY | BRIDGERTON







Our brand atmosphere: royalty, elegance, sophistication, exclusivity, and cinematic anticipation.



This reference establishes how The Royal Cup should look and feel.



02 — TECHNICAL EDITING | ELEVATE RISE







Our technical editing benchmark: dynamic pacing, sophisticated transitions, cinematic movement, visual effects, and precise synchronization.



Applicants must already demonstrate comparable editing capabilities.



03 — LUXURY COCKTAIL PRESENTATION | UNCLE NEAREST







Our beverage presentation standard: pristine glassware, controlled lighting, elegant close-ups, smooth liquid movement, and immaculate visual quality.



Our goal is to elevate cocktail craftsmanship into a luxurious visual experience.



04 — EMOTIONAL IMPACT | GREAT MAN CELEBRATION







Our emotional storytelling benchmark: grandeur, elegance, excitement, celebration, and exclusivity.



The viewer should finish watching and wish they were part of the experience.



OUR CREATIVE STANDARD



- Bridgerton: WHO WE ARE.

- Elevate Rise: HOW PROFESSIONALLY WE EDIT.

- Uncle Nearest: HOW BEAUTIFULLY WE PRESENT COCKTAILS.

- Great Man Celebration: HOW WE WANT THE AUDIENCE TO FEEL.



These are creative references, not instructions to copy copyrighted footage or branding.



If your existing work does not demonstrate comparable cinematic abilities, please do not apply.



----------------------------------------



ABOUT THE ROYAL CUP



The Royal Cup is a luxury private bartending experience specializing in exceptional presentation, refined hospitality, and memorable celebrations.



Our philosophy:



"Where every drink is the perfect drink."



We create experiences that embody luxury, elegance, glamour, and sophistication.



Our established visual identity incorporates royal gold, black, royal purple, polished metals, crystal glassware, dramatic lighting, refined typography, and cinematic storytelling.



Our marketing should resemble a luxury lifestyle film or exclusive gala experience, not a generic retail advertisement.



----------------------------------------



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Transform supplied cocktail and event footage into polished, cinematic Instagram Reels, typically 15–30 seconds.

- Create compelling opening hooks and visually engaging storytelling sequences.

- Apply speed ramping, masking, keyframe animation, motion graphics, sophisticated transitions, and professional sound design.

- Perform color correction and grading for consistent luxury presentation.

- Synchronize visual movement, music, and sound effects.

- Design elegant Instagram graphics and carousels using Canva Pro.

- Follow The Royal Cup's approved logos, typography, colors, and brand guidelines without unauthorized modifications.

- Organize editable project files and maintain professional file management.

- Implement feedback efficiently and professionally.

- Communicate production timelines, concerns, and progress.

- Complete approved deliverables within agreed deadlines and authorized hours.



Exceptional quality takes priority over excessive content volume.



----------------------------------------



COMPENSATION & WORK STRUCTURE



Hourly Rate: $5 USD

Weekly Budget: Up to $35 USD

Authorized Hours: Up to 7 hours weekly

Schedule: Consistent, mutually agreed production blocks

Initial Evaluation: Three weeks, fully paid



The Royal Cup uses a DELIVERABLES-DRIVEN WORKFLOW WITH HOURLY COMPENSATION.



Rather than requiring complex cinematic work to be completed in fragmented one-hour shifts, we allow scheduled production blocks that support uninterrupted creative work.



HOW IT WORKS:



1. Each week, the editor receives a creative brief with approved deliverables, priorities, and deadlines.



2. Work hours are scheduled and authorized in advance.



3. The editor completes assignments while accurately tracking actual working hours.



4. Deliverables are reviewed for cinematic quality, brand consistency, and technical execution.



5. Feedback and revisions are managed within the agreed scope and available paid time.



6. If additional hours are necessary, the editor must notify management before exceeding the authorized allocation so the scope, timeline, or budget can be adjusted.



Additional hours require prior approval. All hours worked must be accurately reported and compensated in accordance with applicable requirements.



The $35 weekly amount is a maximum initial budget, not a guaranteed flat weekly payment. Compensation is based on actual hours worked.



THREE-WEEK PAID EVALUATION



WEEK 1 — CREATIVE ALIGNMENT

Demonstrate your ability to interpret our luxury brand identity and produce polished cinematic content from supplied footage.



WEEK 2 — TECHNICAL EXECUTION

Demonstrate advanced editing capabilities, attention to detail, professional revisions, and consistent brand presentation.



WEEK 3 — INDEPENDENT PRODUCTION

Demonstrate reliability, communication, time management, and the ability to complete assigned work with limited supervision.



Performance will be evaluated based on:



- Cinematic storytelling and visual quality

- Luxury brand alignment

- Technical editing proficiency

- Attention to detail

- Responsiveness to feedback

- Communication and reliability

- Production efficiency and time management



Continued engagement after the evaluation depends on performance, business needs, and mutual agreement.



There is NO separate paid pre-employment editing assessment for this recruitment round.



----------------------------------------



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We are seeking a creative professional who understands the difference between assembling promotional clips and producing an immersive cinematic experience.



The ideal candidate possesses:



- An exceptional eye for luxury presentation

- Advanced, demonstrated video editing skills

- Strong creative judgment and storytelling ability

- Independence and problem-solving skills

- Attention to detail and brand consistency

- Professional communication and reliability

- Accountability and responsiveness to feedback

- A genuine interest in a long-term creative partnership



Experience creating content for luxury hospitality, upscale events, premium lifestyle brands, fashion, fine dining, or high-end promotional films is highly desirable.



----------------------------------------



HOW TO APPLY — REQUIRED QUESTIONS



Answer EVERY question below in numerical order.



Incomplete applications or applications that fail mandatory requirements may be excluded.



1. SOFTWARE VERIFICATION — YES OR NO



Do you CURRENTLY have your own active, paid subscriptions?



CapCut Pro: YES / NO



Canva Pro: YES / NO



Both must be YES to qualify.



Do not answer YES if you use free versions, rely on unauthorized shared access, or intend to upgrade after hiring.



List any additional professional editing software you currently use.



2. LUXURY CINEMATIC PORTFOLIO



After watching all four creative references, provide direct links to THREE existing videos you personally edited that demonstrate comparable cinematic quality.



Prioritize luxury, hospitality, premium lifestyle, fashion, or upscale event content.



Submit three SPECIFIC video links, not an entire portfolio containing unrelated projects.



All links must be accessible without requesting special permissions.



3. EDITING AUTHORSHIP



For each submitted video, briefly explain your personal contributions.



Identify any advanced transitions, speed ramping, masking, motion graphics, keyframe animations, color grading, sound design, or typography you personally completed.



Clearly distinguish your work from collaborative contributions.



4. TECHNICAL REFERENCE ANALYSIS



After watching the Elevate Rise reference, identify THREE specific editing techniques demonstrated in the video.



Explain how you would apply those techniques to footage from a luxury private bartending experience.



5. PRODUCTION TIME



How many working hours would you realistically need to produce one polished 20–30-second cinematic Reel using supplied footage?



State separately:



- Estimated initial editing time

- Estimated time for one round of revisions



Accuracy is more important than unrealistic speed claims.



6. COMPENSATION CONFIRMATION — YES OR NO



Do you accept ALL the following terms?



- $5 USD hourly rate

- Up to 7 authorized hours weekly

- Maximum initial weekly budget of $35

- Consistent, preapproved production blocks

- Deliverables-driven workflow with hourly compensation

- Three-week paid evaluation if selected

- No unauthorized overtime



I ACCEPT ALL TERMS: YES / NO



If your expectations exceed the advertised compensation arrangement, please do not apply.



7. SCHEDULE & AVAILABILITY



Provide:



- Your time zone

- Preferred consistent working hours

- Earliest available start date

- Confirmation you can meet agreed deadlines and maintain approved schedules



----------------------------------------



SELECTION PROCESS



STAGE 1 — QUALIFICATION SCREENING

Verify active CapCut Pro and Canva Pro subscriptions, compensation acceptance, and scheduling compatibility.



STAGE 2 — PORTFOLIO REVIEW

Evaluate three personally edited videos for luxury visual quality, cinematic execution, and brand relevance.



STAGE 3 — TECHNICAL REVIEW

Assess creative knowledge, production estimates, and understanding of our video references.



STAGE 4 — FIRST-ROUND INTERVIEW

Qualified candidates discuss their editing experience, workflow, reliability, and creative approach.



STAGE 5 — THREE-WEEK PAID EVALUATION

The selected candidate completes real assignments under a structured, compensated evaluation.



Only candidates who satisfy the mandatory requirements and demonstrate relevant creative ability will advance.



----------------------------------------



THE OPPORTUNITY



We are not simply searching for someone who can trim footage, add captions, or assemble ordinary promotional advertisements.



We are seeking a creative partner who can transform authentic moments into sophisticated, cinematic experiences that inspire audiences to celebrate, connect, and create lasting memories.



If you already possess the required professional tools, advanced editing capabilities, luxury creative sensibility, and professional discipline, we welcome your application.



The Royal Cup

Where every drink is the perfect drink.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
The role



Keep the money moving. Know when something breaks before a customer does, find out why, and fix it so it can’t happen the same way again.



- Own production health. Alerts, uptime checks and on-call: if a system stops or a payout stops moving, you hear first.

- Run the i
. Take charge when something breaks, keep people updated in plain words, and write a short postmortem that leads to a real fix.

- Fix the code, not just the servers. Most of our failures sit between us and our providers: webhooks, timeouts, retries, duplicate events. Trace them through the code and raise the PR.

- Make deployments and rollbacks boring. One command, repeatable, safe to run on a busy day.

- Plan for capacity. Database size, memory, rate limits, log retention. Act before the limit is hit.

- Write runbooks so anyone on the team can clear a stuck payout.



What we need



- You communicate well. This matters most. During an i
 you say what you know, what you don’t, and what happens next. Clear updates for non-technical people. You ask early instead of guessing, and you respond fast when money is stuck.

- You’ve run production systems. 3+ years running services in production, including on-call. Comfortable on Linux servers over SSH, with process managers, logs and cloud infrastructure (we use AWS). You can find the cause of an outage from logs and metrics alone.

- You can build backend software. You read and write Node.js/TypeScript well enough to fix a bug in a payment flow, with tests. You understand APIs, webhooks, signatures, and safe retries (idempotency).

- You think in failure modes. What happens if the provider is slow, the callback arrives twice, or out of order, or never? What if the database fills up, or the box reboots mid-payout? You design for that instead of finding out in production.



Nice to have



MongoDB at scale (Atlas, indexes, slow queries, capacity). Payments or fintech experience. Monitoring and log tools (Grafana, Datadog, Loki or similar). Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible). CI/CD pipelines.
 bot or messaging 
. Basic security instincts: secrets handling, access control, one tenant seeing another’s data.

title: Growth & Operations Manager — Australian Construction SaaS (Sales, GoHighLevel, Marketing)
description:
Buildops Systems Pty Ltd is seeking an experienced remote contractor to help launch and grow two software brands serving the Australian building industry: a construction CRM and a construction project-management tool. You will work directly with the owner and take ownership of marketing, sales and customer delivery, then help build and manage a team as the brands grow. This is a senior, hands-on role — not an entry-level VA position.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Cold call prospects, run software demos, follow up on enquiries and close sales using approved offers.

- Build and manage GoHighLevel campaigns, pipelines, forms and automations.

- Create social content and videos, landing pages and paid ad campaigns; report results and spend.

- Configure customer CRM accounts, onboard and train customers, and provide first-line support.

- Assess both brands and propose launch priorities, targets and a marketing budget for approval.

- Recruit and assess future team members for approval, then manage their daily delivery and quality.

- Report weekly against agreed targets, keep accurate records and take responsibility for solving problems.



WHAT YOU MUST BRING (please give specific examples of your own results)

- Cold calling and outbound sales to business owners/decision-makers, in fluent, confident spoken English.

- Running software demos and converting prospects to paying customers.

- Paid advertising with measurable results (Meta/Google) — budgets, leads, conversions you can point to.

- Launching or growing a software subscription (SaaS) business.

- GoHighLevel experience — building campaigns, pipelines, automations and dashboards.

- Sales management and client account management / onboarding.

- Exceptional spoken and written English, strong problem-solving, and the ability to own marketing, sales and customer delivery end-to-end with minimal supervision.

- Leadership / managing remote people is a plus. Construction or trades industry experience is a bonus, not required. Product training does not replace the essential skills for this role.



ENGAGEMENT

- Starts at ~20 hours per week, long-term, with a performance and rate review at three months (no guaranteed increase).

- Flexible delivery around agreed meetings and Australian (Perth / AWST) customer appointments.

- Weekly invoicing; payment weekly. Other clients are acceptable outside agreed commitments.

- Time tracking with Trackabi (task descriptions + activity screenshots) is required.

- You must have your own computer, reliable internet with a backup, a power-outage contingency, a quiet workspace, and a quality headset and webcam.

- One-off signup bonuses apply for eligible new customers you personally sign up (full rules provided to shortlisted applicants).



HOW TO APPLY

In your application, please include:

1. A short introduction and your earliest start date and weekly availability (in Perth/AWST time).

2. Your answers to these questions, with specific examples and measurable results:

   - Describe a software subscription (SaaS) business you helped launch or grow — the starting point, what YOU did, and the paying customers or revenue that resulted.

   - Give one cold-calling / sales example where you personally progressed a prospect to payment. What did you say and do?

   - Describe one paid ad campaign you ran — platform, budget, leads, and paying customers — and how you measured attribution.

   - Describe a GoHighLevel workflow you built (triggers, follow-up, stop rules).

3. Two work samples (marketing/video content and sales/operational delivery) using links that can be viewed without requesting access.



Shortlisted applicants complete a short recorded screening interview; the strongest candidates progress to a live second-round interview with the owner. Please redact any confidential client information.

title: UGC & AI Voiceover Ads Video Editor (Advanced English Required)
description:
We're looking for a skilled video editor who specializes in creating engaging UGC-style ads and AI voiceover-based video ads for
 and Instagram.



This is not a general video editing role. We're specifically looking for someone who understands how to edit short-form advertisements that capture attention, maintain viewer engagement, and feel natural to the feed.



Exceptional English comprehension is essential for this position. You need to understand natural English speech, tonality, pacing, emotional emphasis, and how to make AI-generated voiceovers sound like real people.



What You'll Be Doing



1. UGC Video Ad Editing



You'll take raw footage from content creators and turn it into engaging, natural-looking social media advertisements.



Cut and arrange footage to match provided ad scripts.



Select the best takes and remove unnecessary pauses or filler.



Add captions, B-roll, and sound effects where appropriate / whenever instructed.



Create smooth, natural pacing that keeps viewers engaged.



Make ads feel authentic rather than overly edited.



We're not looking for crazy transitions or excessive effects. We want clean, intentional editing that makes the content engaging and easy to follow.



2. AI Voiceover Ad Creation (ElevenLabs)



You'll also be creating more polished video ads using AI-generated voiceovers.



Generate natural-sounding English voiceovers using ElevenLabs.



Adjust pacing, pauses, emphasis, and emotional delivery to match the script.



Identify and fix robotic or unnatural-sounding speech.



Build engaging video ads around the voiceovers using relevant footage, B-roll, captions, graphics, and sound effects.



Ensure the visuals, voiceover, and script work together seamlessly.



We're not looking for someone who simply generates a voiceover and uses the first result. You need to have a good ear for what sounds natural and know how to improve the delivery.



What We're Looking For



Excellent English Comprehension (Non-Negotiable)



This is arguably the most important requirement for this role.



You must have an advanced understanding of spoken English, including conversational tone, natural pronunciation, sentence rhythm, emotional delivery, and word emphasis.



You should be able to listen to a voiceover and immediately recognize when something sounds unnatural, even if the words are technically correct.



Strong Short-Form Ad Editing Skills



Experience editing UGC-style content and social media advertisements.



Understanding of hooks, pacing, storytelling, and viewer retention.



Ability to follow scripts accurately and create videos that flow naturally.



Strong attention to detail when selecting footage, timing cuts, and matching visuals to dialogue.



AI Voiceover Experience



Experience with ElevenLabs is highly preferred, particularly if you've worked with AI-generated voiceovers for advertising.



Reliability & Communication



Ability to follow instructions and implement feedback.



Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.



Consistent communication and ability to meet deadlines.



Willingness to learn and improve over time.



A Quick Question Before You Continue



We value attention to detail and want to work with people who take the time to understand instructions.



When submitting your application, please tell us what your favourite local Filipino meal is and why you like it.



Include your answer at the very start of your application.



Who This Role Is NOT For



This position probably isn't a good fit if:



Your experience is primarily gaming montages, cinematic edits, or long-form YouTube videos.



You rely heavily on flashy transitions rather than clean storytelling and pacing.



You struggle to recognize unnatural English speech or awkward AI voiceovers.



You have little experience working with short-form social media content.



You prefer to improvise rather than closely follow provided scripts.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



Your portfolio: Share 3–5 examples of UGC-style ads, social media advertisements, or AI voiceover videos you've edited.



Your experience: Briefly explain your background editing short-form video ads.



ElevenLabs: Tell us whether you've used ElevenLabs or similar AI voiceover tools before.



English introduction: Include a 30–60-second voice recording introducing yourself in English.



Editing software: Let us know which software you use.



Availability: Let us know how soon you could start.



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a trial to demonstrate their editing skills, English comprehension, and ability to create natural-sounding AI voiceovers.



We're looking for someone reliable, detail-oriented, and interested in becoming a long-term part of our team.

description:
Instinctive Branding is a 15-year-old US based marketing agency seeking an exceptionally talented creative, results-driven, and detail-oriented Short-Form Video Creator who knows how to turn ideas and raw footage into engaging videos that capture attention, drive engagement and viral works be heat too.



This role is perfect for someone who understands more than just video editing. We’re looking for someone who knows how to create compelling hooks, tell stories through video, follow trends, and develop content that people want to watch, share, and engage with.



If you have created Reels that went viral or generated impressive organic views, we want to see your work!



Key Responsibilities

    •    Create and edit engaging short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and
.

    •    Transform raw footage, interviews, and existing content into compelling short videos.

    •    Develop attention-grabbing hooks that capture viewers within the first 1–3 seconds.

    •    Add captions, transitions, music, sound effects, B-roll, and other creative elements.

    •    Research viral content, trending formats, and relevant audio to generate new ideas.

    •    Repurpose long-form content into multiple short-form videos.

    •    Follow brand guidelines and maintain visual consistency across client accounts.

    •    Collaborate with the team to brainstorm content ideas and improve video performance.

    •    Review available analytics and recommend ways to improve engagement and audience retention.

    •    Meet deadlines and manage video projects according to established content calendars and trackers.



Required Skills

    •    Advanced video editing skills using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Canva, or similar tools.

    •    Proven experience creating Instagram Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, or other short-form videos.

    •    Strong understanding of hooks, storytelling, pacing, captions, and audience retention.

    •    Ability to identify trends and adapt them to different brands and audiences.

    •    Excellent attention to detail and a strong sense of visual storytelling.

    •    Ability to follow creative briefs, brand guidelines, and feedback.

    •    Comfortable using AI tools to support content research, ideation, scripting, and editing workflows.

    •    Ability to manage tasks independently and consistently meet deadlines.



Preferred Qualifications

    •    Previous experience as a Video Editor, Social Media Manager, or Content Creator.

    •    Experience creating videos that achieved high organic reach or went viral.

    •    Understanding of social media analytics, including views, watch time, shares, saves, and engagement.

    •    Experience editing talking-head videos, interviews, podcasts, educational content, or promotional videos.

    •    Ability to suggest creative concepts, write hooks, and improve existing video ideas.

    •    Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.



What We're Looking For

We want someone who is creative, curious, and proactive. Someone who doesn't simply follow instructions but can also bring fresh ideas to the table.

Our ideal candidate:

    •    Understands what makes people stop scrolling.

    •    Can explain why a video performed well and how to apply those lessons to future content.

    •    Is comfortable experimenting with different hooks, formats, and editing styles.

    •    Takes ownership of their work and pays attention to the little details.

    •    Is organized, reliable, and open to constructive feedback.

    •    Can work independently while collaborating with a creative team.

    •    Focuses on creating effective content, not just making videos look good.



Show Us Your Viral Reels!

This is an important part of your application. Without this, we aren’t interested. 

We want to see what you've actually created and how your videos performed.



Please include:

    •    Links to at least 3–5 Reels, TikToks, or YouTube Shorts you personally created.

    •    Links to at least 2–3 of your best-performing videos, preferably those with high organic views.

    •    The view counts and engagement results for your strongest videos.

    •    A brief explanation of your role in each video, including whether you handled editing, scripting, concept development, filming, or the entire production.

    •    One example of a video you believe performed particularly well and a short explanation of why you think it succeeded.

Values We Admire

    •    Creativity in approach and problem-solving.

    •    Team players who collaborate well.

    •    Honest and transparent communication.

    •    Kindness and consideration toward others.

    •    Accountability and pride in delivering quality work.

    •    A positive attitude and someone who's fun to work with, even on Zoom!



How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:

    1    Your resume.

    2    A brief introduction about yourself and your video editing experience.

    3    Your portfolio with direct links to your best videos.

    4    Examples of high-performing or viral Reels, including view counts and engagement results.

    5    A brief explanation of what made one of your videos successful.

    6    The editing tools and AI tools you use.

title: Spanish-Speaking Medical Virtual Assistant
description:
• Pay: USD 750 a month base, plus performance incentives with no cap. Our top performers take home USD 1,300 to 1,500 a month.

• Shift: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM US Eastern (10 PM to 7 AM in Manila), with some weekend shifts for coverage

• Benefits: HMO from your third month, flexible paid time off

• Where: fully remote, from a quiet room at home

• Languages: fluent spoken Spanish and English. You call patients in both.



A CALL, FOR EXAMPLE

Your first call of the day is to a woman in her sixties with COPD who speaks only Spanish. Her health system referred her to us last week. She asks how you got her number, and says her daughter usually deals with her doctors. In Spanish, you explain who we are and how our team can help her stay well at home, answer her questions, and book her first visit. Your next call is in English.



THE JOB

Health systems across the US refer older patients with heart failure or COPD to us, often after a hospital stay. Many of them speak Spanish. You call them, explain in plain words how our doctors, nurses and respiratory therapists can care for them at home, and book their first video visit. For a patient who speaks Spanish, you are the first person at AnsibleHealth they can talk to in their own language.



You make 45 to 60 calls a day. Most go to voicemail, and about a dozen become real conversations. Some patients are wary, some are tired of doctors, some just want someone to listen. Your job is to help each one decide whether to join, and to get them to a first visit within a week or so. Between calls you schedule visits, keep patient records up to date and work with our clinical team.



WHAT YOU NEED



• Fluent spoken Spanish that a Spanish-speaking patient in the US understands the first time, including medicine names, numbers and times

• Clear spoken English that a US patient understands the first time

• 2 or more years on the phone in customer service or healthcare

• Comfort with clinical topics: nursing or other clinical training, or healthcare work where you talked with patients about their conditions

• A quiet room, internet of 30 Mbps or faster, and a backup for outages

• Availability for this shift for the long term

A healthcare degree, US healthcare accounts, sales or appointment-setting experience, or calls handled in Spanish at work are a plus.



This is a phone job with daily targets, not back-office or email work. If you like talking with people and helping them say yes to care, you will do well here.



HOW TO APPLY (ABOUT 20 MINUTES)



1. Apply only at https://www.ansiblehealth.com/careers/jobs/spanish-speaking-medical-virtual-assistant/apply?ref=vtk2amhw . Applications sent any other way are not reviewed.

2. Answer a few quick questions in English.

3. Complete the Spanish section of the form. Its instructions are below, in Spanish only.

4. Record your voice on the form, first in English and then in Spanish. Each time you read three lines from a real call, then answer a patient in your own words (about ten minutes in all).

5. Give your earliest start date and the notice you owe your current employer.



EN ESPAÑOL

Esta parte del anuncio está solo en español, a propósito: en este trabajo usted llama a pacientes que hablan español. En la solicitud le pedimos tres cosas en español:



1. Escribir la palabra clave. Cuando el formulario le pida la palabra clave, escriba GIRASOL.

2. Responder por escrito una pregunta breve.

3. Grabar su voz: leer tres frases de una llamada real y responderle a una paciente con sus propias palabras.



If you are shortlisted, we email you a link to book a 15-minute call with our recruiter.

title: YouTube Scriptwriter and Recording Outline Writer - Research provided
description:
⚠️ PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING:



Please read the full post before applying. We’re looking for someone who understands the role.

If you’ve read this, start your application with “I READ THE BRIEF” and follow the instructions under How to Apply.

Applications that don’t follow the instructions may not be considered.



—



YouTube Scriptwriter and Recording Outline Writer

Research provided



I’m Shane, the creator behind Repzilla. I’m looking for a writer to turn my research into engaging recording scripts and outlines for long-form commentary and documentary videos.



I supply labeled clips, screenshots, links, research notes, and the intended angle. You organize that material into a story I can follow naturally while recording, develop the reasoning, and write the connections between sections.





WHAT YOU WILL CREATE:



- A complete recording document with short scripted introductions, explanations, and transitions where useful.



- Original research labels and clickable links at the point of use, with relevant timestamps and playback or cutoff instructions.



- Concise commentary prompts such as “go over” or “read & react,” with more developed points when the reasoning needs explanation.



- Occasional editor notes for visuals, cuts, and B-roll, plus a short list of unresolved questions.





Preserve the original research labels exactly. You may arrange sources in any order that serves the story, and the same label must be reused when returning to the same source. I use those labels to search my research and find what to open next.



The writing should fit each moment. Develop complex explanations and leave room for natural reactions. Handle supplied evidence accurately, preserve relevant context and responses, and flag unsupported conclusions or missing material. Additional investigation is scoped separately.



Videos may run around 60 minutes or longer when the material supports it. Estimate speaking and clip playback separately; avoid padding the story to reach a runtime. Maine coordinates assignments and feedback, and I provide editorial approval.





HOW TO APPLY:



Send two relevant scripts or recording outlines, preferably with the finished videos, and explain which parts you created. 



Include your availability, expected turnaround, and quote after reviewing a sample research packet.



Shortlisted candidates will receive a format example and complete a paid test for a section estimated at 5–8 minutes of finished video. 



We agree on scope, fee, deadline, and any included revision in advance. 



Completed tests are paid regardless of selection. Be prepared to explain your story order and show how a claim connects to its source.

title: Create AI Thumbnails for YouTube
description:
# We're Hiring: AI YouTube Thumbnail Designer



We are a growing YouTube media company managing multiple channels across very different niches, including boats, engines, infrastructure, engineering, and many more.



We're looking for an **AI Thumbnail Designer with exceptional adaptability, a highly critical visual eye, and an excellent command of English.**



Our thumbnails are primarily created using ChatGPT's image generation capabilities and then refined using any simple image-editing software.



**WE DO NOT ACCEPT GENERIC, LOW-EFFORT AI-GENERATED THUMBNAILS.**



We don't want someone who simply follows templates or uses the same visual style for every project.



We need someone capable of learning new visual styles quickly, adapting to completely different audiences, and constantly improving the quality of their work.



**A very high level of English is essential for this position.** You must be able to understand complex video titles, detailed instructions, subtle meanings, and feedback naturally and accurately.



## What Matters Most to Us



**1. EXTREME ADAPTABILITY**



This is our number one priority.



You'll work across many YouTube channels with completely different audiences and visual identities.



One day, you might create an ultra-realistic thumbnail featuring massive boat engines. The next, you might work on an infrastructure video requiring maps or an entirely different visual approach.



We need someone who can:



- Learn unfamiliar visual styles quickly.

- Understand what works for different audiences.

- Adapt to new niches without relying on one specific design formula.

- Accept feedback and immediately apply what they've learned.

- Continuously evolve their approach as our channels develop.



**2. EXCEPTIONAL VISUAL JUDGMENT**



We need someone with a strong critical eye.



You must be able to identify when an image looks artificial, unconvincing, poorly composed, confusing, or simply not impactful enough.



You should be capable of recognizing problems and improving the result independently, without needing detailed instructions for every correction.



**3. CREATIVITY**



Creativity still matters, but we value the ability to understand, adapt, and execute different styles more than producing completely original concepts every time.



We want thoughtful visual decisions, not creativity for its own sake.



## Your Responsibilities



- Generate high-quality, ultra-realistic AI images using ChatGPT.

- Design compelling YouTube thumbnails across multiple niches.

- Learn and reproduce different visual styles while adapting them to new subjects.

- Use any simple image-editing software for occasional minor adjustments.

- Make small corrections to AI-generated imperfections when needed.

- Add simple text, arrows, labels, or visual elements when appropriate.

- Revise thumbnails based on feedback and apply those lessons to future projects.



**Important:** Most of the visual work will be done directly through ChatGPT image generation. Advanced Photoshop skills or complex manual image manipulation are NOT required. We only expect basic editing abilities for very small finishing touches.



## Requirements



- Experience generating images with ChatGPT or comparable AI tools.

- Ability to produce convincing, photorealistic images.

- Basic familiarity with any image-editing program, such as Canva, Photopea, GIMP, or similar.

- Excellent visual judgment and attention to detail.

- Outstanding adaptability and willingness to learn.

- Understanding of composition, contrast, typography, and visual storytelling.

- Ability to work independently and follow instructions.

- **Advanced English proficiency (B2-C1 level or equivalent) — REQUIRED.**

- **Strong reading comprehension and written communication in English. You must understand nuanced titles, complex instructions, and detailed feedback without relying on translation tools.**

- Reliable communication and interest in long-term collaboration.



Previous experience designing YouTube thumbnails is welcome but **not mandatory**.



We value potential, adaptability, and visual judgment over years of experience.



## What We Offer



- Long-term remote collaboration.

- Flexible working hours.

- Work across a wide variety of YouTube niches.

- Clear guidance and feedback.

- Opportunities to develop your skills as our channels grow.

- **Compensation: $1 USD per completed thumbnail, including minor image adjustments.**



## HOW TO APPLY: DISC Assessment



Please include your DISC assessment results (Dominance, Influence, Steadiness, Compliance).



We are not expecting you to already know our visual styles. We will provide guidance and help you understand our channels.



What we're looking for is someone who can learn quickly, adapt exceptionally well, recognize visual weaknesses, and consistently improve their work.



Start your application with the word **ADAPTABLE** so we know you've read the entire description.



We're looking forward to hearing from you!

Scaling: Increase spend systematically when campaigns demonstrate profitable, repeatable performance.

Reporting: Provide concise weekly reports covering spend, revenue, CAC, ROAS, key learnings, and next actions.

 Compensation

title: AI-Assisted Customer Support Specialist (Email & Social Media) | US Shopify Brand | Full Time
description:
➤ Who we are

We are a fast-growing DTC e-commerce brand selling to women in the US, Canada and the UK. Orders are growing fast. Our support team has two full-time agents today, and the volume now needs a third.

We are not the average e-commerce brand that stops caring once the order is paid. We want every customer happy, and a brand reputation that is spotless. That is why this role matters to us.



➤ This is not a typing job. It's a thinking job.

Customer support here is not about writing replies anymore. Our AI drafts the replies, and most of them are already very good.

Your job is to think: read every draft, check the order and the facts, fix what's wrong, and d
 what gets sent. You will work with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) all day. We need a sharp brain, not a fast typist.

And you own your queue. Every customer gets an answer. Every order problem gets followed until it is solved. Nothing gets forgotten. You don't need anyone to remind you.



➤ The team and your shift

You join two agents who already cover the US evening and the US night. You take the third shift, right after them: 1:00 PM to 9:00 PM Philippine time. With you, support runs around the clock, and the three of you hand over to each other.

A day shift is rare for a US brand. Here is why yours matters:

• Our UK customers are awake during your shift. You are their support team.

• Our supplier and fulfillment partners are in Asia, online at the same time as you. You are the one who gets answers from them the same day.

• You clear what is left in the inbox, so the US day starts with a clean queue. On the days one of your teammates is off, you carry a bigger part of that queue.

• Your shift is the calm one: fewer new tickets come in, so you have time to think. You are the person with the full picture: what is stuck, what was promised, what needs a follow-up.

• Before you log off, you brief the night agent: what happened, what is open, what to watch.



➤ What you will do

Customers always come first: support and comments are your priority every day. Supplier follow-ups fill the rest of your shift, and creator partnerships come later.



1. Customer support 
, AI-assisted)

• Review every AI-drafted reply in our inbox (Help Scout): check the order in Shopify and the tracking, correct or rewrite with AI when needed, then send.

• Handle order status, shipping delays, returns, refunds, exchanges and address changes.

• Handle sensitive cases calmly: upset customers, disputes and chargebacks.

• Spot when the AI gets something wrong, and report it so the system keeps getting better.



2. Social media moderation

• Check comments on our
 and Instagram pages and ads, every day.

• Reply, hide spam, and turn public complaints into solved tickets.



3. Supplier and fulfillment follow-up

• Follow up with our supplier and fulfillment partners on delayed, lost or wrong orders, while they are online.

• Make sure every stuck order gets a solution, and the customer hears about it.



4. Content creator partnerships (later, as the role grows)

• We are starting to work with content creators and influencers. It is close to customer support: you write to people, answer their questions, and follow up until it is done.

• Reach out to creators, coordinate product shipments, and track the content we receive.

• This is not for day one. It comes when support is under control and you have time in your shift.



➤ Schedule

• Full time, 6 days a week. Your day off is fixed: Wednesday, Thursday or Friday, agreed together.

• Shift: 1:00 PM to 9:00 PM Philippine time, 8 hours with 1 hour of breaks inside, so 7 hours of work a day. No night work, no split shift.

• The shift can move by one hour when the US changes its clocks.

• Being open to a 7th day during peak season is a big plus (paid extra).

• 100% remote, from the South East Asia time zone (Philippines preferred). Fast, reliable internet and a backup plan for power outages.

• Start: as soon as possible.



➤ Who you are

• Must have: 2+ years of customer support for an e-commerce brand on Shopify. This is required.

• Must have: you already use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) regularly. If you don't use AI today, this role is not for you. We will train you on our system.

• A sharp, analytical mind: you read carefully, check the facts, and catch mistakes, including the AI's.

• Excellent written English: warm, clear and professional.

• Organized and detail-oriented. To prove it: in the application form, start your answer about the Shopify brands you supported with the word banana.

• Responsible. You follow up without being reminded, and you bring solutions, not only problems.

• Experience with a helpdesk (Help Scout, Gorgias, Zendesk or similar).

• Experience with
 and Instagram comment moderation.

• Bonus: experience talking to suppliers or fulfillment partners.

• Bonus: experience with influencer or content creator (UGC) outreach.



➤ What's in it for you

💰 $1,000 a month, paid on time, twice a month.

📊 Performance bonuses.

☀️ A day shift. Your evenings end at 9 PM and your nights are yours.

🚀 Room to grow: more responsibility and a higher salary as the brand grows.

🤝 A long-term, stable role with a brand that is actively scaling.

👤 Direct work with the founder, in a small team that already runs well.

title: Operations Manager
description:

Core Group Company (CGC)



Location: Remote (Philippines)

Work Schedule: 3rd Shift -- U.S. Night Hours (approx. 10 PM - 7 AM PHT)

Industry: Technology Consulting / ERP Implementation / Business Solutions







About Core Group Company

Core Group Company (CGC) is a U.S.-based technology consulting firm specializing in ERP implementation, business process optimization, software development, and technology solutions. We help businesses streamline operations, improve efficiency, and maximize the value of their technology investments.



As we continue to grow, we're looking for an experienced Operations Manager who can bring structure, accountability, and operational excellence to our team.







About the Role

We are seeking a proactive, organized, and results-driven Operations Manager to oversee daily operations, coordinate project delivery, manage resources, support our sales team, and ensure smooth collaboration across teams.



This is a 3rd shift, full-time role designed to cover U.S. business hours from the Philippines. You will work closely with executive leadership, our Account Executive, project teams, functional consultants, and developers to ensure operational priorities are clearly defined, projects remain on track, and commitments are consistently followed through.



The ideal candidate brings strong experience in operations management, project coordination, team leadership, sales operations support, and process improvement -- preferably within a technology consulting, software development, or ERP implementation environment.



This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can manage multiple priorities, maintain operational visibility, and drive continuous improvement.







Key Responsibilities

Operations & Team Management



Facilitate daily operational standup meetings and monitor progress, priorities, and blockers.

Coordinate with team leads, developers, and functional consultants to ensure timely execution.

Monitor team workloads, resource utilization, capacity, and availability.

Identify operational challenges, escalate blockers, and coordinate solutions.

Ensure accountability for assigned tasks, deadlines, and commitments.

Maintain established operating procedures and recurring meeting schedules.

Project & Task Management



Create, assign, and track tasks in Jira; maintain project boards and status updates.

Coordinate project schedules, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables.

Identify overdue tasks, delivery risks, and resource constraints.

Convert meeting action items and leadership directives into actionable Jira tickets.

Support setup and coordination of new client engagements.

Client Coordination & Communication



Coordinate client meetings and prepare Minutes of Meeting (MoM) documentation.

Track client commitments and ensure follow-through.

Collaborate with account management and technical teams on client requirements.

Escalate unresolved client issues to leadership.

Sales Operations Support (~25-30% of role)



Keep the Odoo CRM pipeline current -- opportunity stages, next activities, and notes after each sales call.

Schedule discovery and follow-up calls; send confirmations and reminders to prospects.

Prepare proposal and SOW drafts from CGC templates for the Account Executive to finalize.

Post call summaries and update opportunities after recorded sales calls.

Manage the lead nurture queue and flag stalled or overdue opportunities weekly.

Reporting & Performance Monitoring



Prepare weekly operational reports, leadership meeting agendas, and project status summaries.

Monitor key metrics including team utilization, capacity, and project performance.

Track operational risks, outstanding deliverables, and improvement opportunities.

Ensure recurring administrative reviews are completed accurately and on time.

Systems & Process Improvement



Coordinate internal systems projects and operational improvement initiatives.

Maintain and improve workflows across ERP, CRM, project management, and collaboration platforms.

Monitor lead management and business automation workflows.

Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Coordinate Microsoft 365 license audits and administrative reviews.

Recruitment & Administrative Support



Support recruitment activities including candidate tracking and interview coordination.

Coordinate employee onboarding, Odoo profile setup, and system access requests.

Maintain organizational charts and employee documentation.

Monitor designated
 accounts and handle recurring administrative tasks.

Qualifications

Required



Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Information Technology, or equivalent professional experience.

At least 5 years of experience in operations management, project management, or service delivery.

Experience coordinating remote teams and managing multiple projects simultaneously.

Hands-on experience with Jira, Asana, Monday, or a similar project management tool.

Experience with CRM, ERP, or business management systems.

Experience supporting sales operations -- CRM pipeline hygiene, scheduling, lead nurturing, and proposal preparation.

Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Experience developing SOPs and improving operational processes.

Experience with ERP systems; hands-on Odoo implementation experience (functional configuration, go-lives, or client training) is strongly preferred.

Willingness to pursue and obtain Odoo Functional Consultant certification if not already certified.

Willingness and availability to work 3rd shift -- U.S. night hours (approx. 10 PM - 7 AM PHT).

Preferred



Experience in technology consulting, software development, ERP implementation, or managed services.

Hands-on Odoo ERP implementation experience (functional configuration, go-lives, or client training) -- this is a strong differentiator.

Odoo Functional Consultant certification, or active commitment to obtaining it within the first year.

Experience with Jira and Confluence.

Knowledge of Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and collaboration tools.

Experience monitoring team utilization, capacity, and operational KPIs.

Experience with CRM automation and marketing automation tools (e.g., Odoo CRM / Marketing Automation).

Familiarity with the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS).

What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days -- Familiarization



Understand CGC's organizational structure, active projects, sales pipeline, and operational processes.

Become familiar with Odoo, Jira, Confluence, and Microsoft 365 workflows.

Establish working relationships with leadership and team members.

First 60 Days -- Operational Ownership



Independently coordinate daily operations, standups, and project follow-ups.

Own CRM hygiene and sales scheduling for the Account Executive.

Maintain accurate task tracking, resource monitoring, and operational reporting.

Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency.

First 90 Days -- Process Optimization



Demonstrate consistent ownership of assigned operational responsibilities.

Maintain clear visibility into project progress, resource availability, and business priorities.

Implement approved improvements to workflows and processes.

Why Join Core Group Company?

Work fully remotely with a U.S.-based technology consulting company.

Collaborate with experienced professionals across business and technology functions.

Gain exposure to ERP implementations, software development, sales operations, and business automation.

Take on a role with meaningful responsibility and direct impact on company operations.

Competitive hourly compensation: P700 - P1,000 per hour based on experience (approx. ₱120,000 – ₱175,000 per month at 40 hrs/week).



How to Apply

Interested candidates are encouraged to submit:





An updated resume.

A brief summary (3-5 sentences) of your most relevant operations management and sales support experience.

Confirmation of your availability to work 3rd shift (approx. 10 PM - 7 AM PHT; 7 AM - 4 PM MT in winter, 8 AM - 5 PM MT in summer).



Join Core Group Company and help us build efficient, scalable, and results-driven operations.

title: Virtual Assistant — Social Media & Lead Generation for Naytira's Rentals
description:
Virtual Assistant — Social Media & Lead Generation

Naytira's Rentals — 360 photo booth, mirror photo booth, and keepsake station for keychains.



Help a growing photo booth company stay visible online and turn holiday-season interest — especially from corporate clients — into real bookings.



Type: Part-time, Remote — Virtual Assistant

Hours: 15 hours per week, flexible schedule

Pay: $4.00 per hour, plus a $20 bonus for every lead secured

Start: As soon as possible

Employment type: Independent contractor



About Naytira's Rentals



Naytira's Rentals is a photo booth rental company that helps guests make and keep memories at parties, weddings, school and community events, and corporate celebrations. Clients can book a 360 photo booth or a mirror photo booth, and add a keepsake station that turns guests' photos into keychains they take home. We are a small, hands-on business. That means your work will be seen, your ideas will be heard, and good work will show up directly in inquiries and bookings — not disappear into a big team.



Why this role, why now



We are at the start of the holiday season — the busiest time of year for company holiday parties, end-of-year celebrations, and staff appreciation events. Companies are choosing entertainment now, and they often find and judge vendors on social media first. We need someone consistent and proactive who will keep us posting, keep us engaging, and actively reach out to corporate prospects while demand is high. After the holidays, the same work carries into weddings, birthdays, graduations, and events year-round.



What you will do



1. Social Media Management



Plan and maintain a simple weekly content calendar for our social media accounts, so we post consistently without last-minute scrambling. Create, schedule, and publish posts, Reels / short videos, and Stories using photos and video from real events — 360 booth clips, mirror booth moments, and keepsake station photos. Write clear, friendly captions in our voice, with relevant hashtags and a clear call to action (check a date, send a message, request a quote). Repurpose our best event content: turn one event into several posts, highlight reels, and seasonal promotions. Engage daily: reply to comments and direct messages promptly, thank clients and vendors who tag us, and flag any inquiry that needs a fast personal reply. Keep profiles current — bio, highlights, pinned posts, booking links, and holiday availability / offer posts. Track what works each week (reach, saves, shares, profile visits, and inquiries) and suggest what to do more or less of.



2. Lead Generation & Corporate Outreach



Research and build targeted lead lists: local companies, offices, HR and office managers, event planners, venues, schools, and organizations likely to host holiday and corporate events. Send thoughtful outreach by
 and social media using approved templates — and personalize each message; no mass spam. Follow up politely and persistently on schedule, so interested prospects do not go cold. Monitor and respond to leads on Bark and any other listing or inquiry platforms we use, keeping response times fast. Qualify each lead before handing it over: event date, type of event, location, estimated guest count, which booth they want, and contact details. Keep a clean, up-to-date lead tracker: source, contact, date contacted, follow-ups, status, and next step for every prospect. Report weekly on outreach sent, replies, qualified leads secured, and dates handed over for booking.



What you will also help with



Inbox support: Sort social and
 inquiries, draft replies for approval, and make sure no inquiry sits unanswered. Review and referral requests: Message past clients after events to thank them, request a review, and ask about upcoming events. Vendor connections: Engage with venues, planners, DJs, and caterers online and note partnership or referral opportunities. Light admin: Organize event photos and videos, name and file content so it is easy to reuse, and keep our lead and content trackers tidy.



Pay highlight — lead bonus: You will earn a $20 bonus whenever you secure a lead, on top of your base pay. Good outreach is directly rewarded here, because leads are the point of this role.



What success looks like



In your first 30 days — what we expect to see:

Social media: Profiles cleaned up and current, a weekly content calendar running, and consistent posting using our existing event photos and videos.

Lead generation: A lead tracker set up, a first targeted list of corporate and holiday-event prospects built, and outreach and follow-up underway.

Communication: A short weekly update: what was posted, who was contacted, what replies came in, and which leads were secured.



By 60 days, success is a steady rhythm — consistent content, no lead left without a follow-up, and a visible flow of qualified inquiries for holiday and upcoming events. We care more about inquiries and secured leads than follower counts alone.



You must have



- Experience managing social media for a business, brand, or client — please be ready to show examples.

- Experience with lead generation, outreach, sales support, or customer follow-up.

- Strong, friendly written English for captions, messages, and
s.

- Confidence creating short-form content (Reels / TikTok-style video, Stories) from phone photos and clips.

- Organization you can prove: you keep trackers, lists, and follow-up dates accurate without being chased.

- Reliability: you work your agreed hours, meet posting and follow-up deadlines, and communicate early if something will be late.

- A phone or computer, reliable internet, and comfort working remotely.



Nice to have

Tools you will use

title: Full-Time B2B Cold Caller (Canada): Guaranteed Base + Bonus for Every Meeting Held
description:
Good on the phone? This job pays you for it.



We're Canadian Funding Partners, a private Canadian company that helps businesses get government funding. You'll phone owners of small and mid-size Canadian businesses and book short calls with our specialists. You don't sell and you don't close. You open the door, and our team does the rest.



WHY GOOD CALLERS LIKE THIS JOB

- A real offer. Many owners don't know there's funding for their business, so you're calling with something useful.

- You book; you don't close. Your goal is a 15-minute call on the calendar.

- Fresh leads and a fast power dialer, ready on day one.

- Pay that rewards results: a guaranteed monthly base, plus a bonus for every meeting that's held. No cap on bonuses.

- Your numbers speak for you. Every call is measured automatically, so good work gets seen. Hit the numbers and we leave you alone.

- Your trial day is paid.



PAY

- A guaranteed monthly base, paid twice a month.

- Plus a bonus for every meeting you book that is held. No cap.

- A meeting counts as held when the owner shows up, is qualified (incorporated, 5 or more staff), and is interested in using AI in their business. We confirm this after each meeting.

- We share the exact figures with shortlisted applicants.



HOURS: Monday to Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern (10:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. Philippine time).



WHAT A NORMAL DAY LOOKS LIKE

- 120+ dials on a power dialer

- 4+ hours actually on the phone

- Every missed callback returned within 15 minutes

- One lunch break. No disappearing.



THIS JOB IS FOR YOU IF

- you've done at least 1 year of outbound cold calling or appointment setting, ideally B2B to North America

- your spoken English is clear and confident

- you have a quiet room, a noise-cancelling headset, a computer, internet of 25 Mbps or more, and a backup connection

- you can work the hours above, every weekday

- French is a plus, not required



IT'S NOT FOR YOU IF

- you can't make 120 calls a day, every day

- rejection gets to you

- you need weeks of training before you're good

- you want a quiet, low-pressure job (this is the opposite)

- your internet or your room isn't reliable



HOW WE HIRE (FAST)

1. You send the application below.

2. We listen to every recording. Shortlisted applicants get a short prep guide and a 15-minute AI calling test (about 12 practice calls that get harder). The best then do a live mock call with us.

3. Those who pass do one paid trial day on real calls.

4. Then we review day by day. Hit the numbers and you stay.



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY, THIS IS PART OF THE TEST)



 
 with this exact subject line:

Caller – [Your full name] – [Dials per day at your last job]



The first line of your
 must be the word MAPLE.

3. Recording 2: your answer, in your own words, to "I'm busy, just send me an
." (60 seconds max)

Position Overview



Vertex Total Operations is seeking highly experienced, aggressive, and results-driven Sales Professionals with a strong background in the BPO, outsourcing, recruitment, or remote staffing industry to drive business growth and secure new commercial clients.



We are specifically looking for proven sales performers who knows how to approach business decision-makers, generate qualified opportunities, negotiate service agreements, and consistently close deals.



Our ideal candidate is not someone who needs extensive sales training. We want an experienced professional who already knows how to prospect, pitch, handle objections, build a sales pipeline, and convert prospects into paying clients.

This is a 100% remote, commission-based opportunity for sales professionals with a proven track record in B2B sales, client acquisition, and business development.

If you have experience selling BPO services, outsourcing solutions, recruitment services, or remote staffing solutions and can demonstrate your ability to bring in new clients, we want to hear from you.



Key Responsibilities



•	Identify, research, and approach potential business clients through cold calling,
 outreach, LinkedIn, networking, referrals, and other prospecting strategies.

•	Actively generate qualified B2B leads and develop new business opportunities.

•	Identify companies that need outsourcing, remote staffing, recruitment, and workforce solutions.

•	Present Vertex Total Operations' services to business owners, executives, HR directors, operations managers, and other key decision-makers.

•	Maintain accurate lead records, sales activities, and follow-ups using a CRM system.

•	Consistently pursue sales targets, client acquisition goals, and revenue objectives.

•	Provide regular updates on sales performance, pipeline progress, and closed deals.



Qualifications:



•	Minimum 8–10 years of proven sales or business development experience.

•	Previous experience selling BPO, outsourcing, remote staffing, recruitment, or offshore staffing services is strongly preferred.

•	Proven track record of closing B2B deals and acquiring new commercial clients.

•	Strong understanding of the BPO and outsourcing industry, including offshore staffing and workforce solutions.

•	Experience selling services to business owners, executives, HR departments, and operations decision-makers.

•	Excellent prospecting, cold calling, lead generation, negotiation, and closing abilities.

•	Ability to independently manage the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to contract signing.

•	Strong objection-handling, presentation, and client relationship management skills.

•	Proficiency in CRM systems, LinkedIn Sales Navigator,
 prospecting tools, and other sales technologies.

•	Excellent written and spoken English.

•	Highly motivated, competitive, accountable, and results-oriented.

•	Ability to work independently and deliver measurable sales results in a remote environment.

•	Reliable computer, high-speed internet connection, and a professional remote workspace.



Position Details



Work Setup: 100% Remote

Engagement Type: Independent Contractor

Compensation: Commission-Based

Experience Required :Minimum 8–10 Years

Preferred Background: Remote Staffing, Offshore Staffing, Recruitment, BPO Sales



About Vertex Total Operations



Vertex Total Operations helps businesses reduce operational and staffing costs by connecting them with qualified remote professionals who support their business operations and growth.

We provide outsourcing and remote staffing solutions that help companies access skilled talent while improving efficiency and managing workforce expenses.

We are looking for exceptional salespeople who can identify companies that need outsourcing solutions, communicate our value effectively, develop strong business relationships, and convert prospects into long-term clients.

title: AI CONTENT CREATOR & VIDEO EDITOR
description:
Hey 👋



I run an AI content agency. We make short form video using AI avatars, built with Veo and Flow, for our own brands and for clients across a few different markets.



Let me be honest about who I’m looking for



I’m not looking for someone who wants a job. I’m looking for someone who actually cares about the work.



The difference shows up fast. People who are just here for the money do the minimum, ignore feedback, and plateau. People who care get obsessed with why one video hits and another doesn’t, and they get better every single week.



I already have creators like that. They’re brilliant, they push each other, and they’ve built something I’m proud of. I’m only adding people who raise that standard, not dilute it.



If that sounds intense, it probably isn’t for you. If it sounds like what you’ve been looking for, keep reading.



What you’d actually do



Create short form videos using AI avatars, working from prompts and guides I provide.



Each video takes around an hour once you’re up to speed. The minimum is 2 videos a day per account, which works out at 14 a week. Finish them early and the rest of your week is yours.



What you get that you won’t get elsewhere



I share everything. Prompts, techniques, what’s working, what’s failing. I make the videos myself first so I hit the problems before you do.



We pioneer content in this space, so there’s often a new style to learn week to week. You’ll be building skills that barely exist in the market yet.



And you’ll be alongside creators who are genuinely good. That matters more than people realise.



The one fixed commitment



Sunday group calls, 7 PM Philippines time, every week. That’s where I give feedback and we level up together. It’s the single biggest reason our standard keeps climbing, so it isn’t optional.



What I need from you



Coachable. I give real feedback and we run proper revisions. If criticism stings rather than motivates, this won’t work.



Communicative. If you’re stuck, tell me. Don’t disappear and don’t guess.



Reliable. If you say it’s coming, it comes.



Quality over volume. I’d rather have one great video than three rushed ones.



The pay will be 3$ an hour as most videos takes around that time to make whilst learning new process and techniques, after a while the time frame should shrink within 30-45mins to make.



I’m telling you this early so nobody wastes their time.



How to apply



Tell me, in your own words:



- Why AI content genuinely interests you, not a textbook answer.

Something you’ve made with AI tools, even if it’s rough. Link it



- What you’re currently working on and how many hours you could commit



- How you handle feedback when someone tells you your work isn’t good enough yet

This is not a standard admin or call-center job. You will work side by side with the owner, take the growing to-do list off their plate, and make sure things actually get done. You will coordinate between teams, follow up on open items, and keep everything moving. You will not be the main person answering every parent call or booking every class, but you will be the person who keeps it all connected.



This is a senior role. Over time you will take full ownership of key parts of the company's operations that the owner currently runs personally, and you will be accountable for the results. We are looking for someone who has done this before and wants real responsibility, not someone who waits to be told what to do.



You do not need to speak Mandarin. Some of our clients and staff do, so you will use AI tools to translate and draft messages when needed, and you will be expected to do this quickly and carefully.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Act as the central coordination point between the owner, teachers, and staff

- Take ownership of key operational areas, run them end to end, and report results to the owner, with the scope growing as you prove yourself

- Turn the owner's instructions into a clear, prioritized to-do list, then work through it one task at a time

- Execute on tasks quickly and correctly, with minimal follow-up needed

- Write clear SOPs (standard operating procedures) from the instructions and examples the owner gives you

- Support teacher recruitment and onboarding

- Use AI tools to translate and write messages for Mandarin-speaking families and staff, check them for accuracy and tone, and flag anything sensitive or unclear before sending

- Step in on phone, WeChat, and scheduling tasks when the owner needs support

- Keep shared documents, trackers, and records organized in Google Workspace



MUST HAVES

- Fluent spoken and written English at a native or near-native level. This is essential, and you will be assessed on it, including on the phone.

- Very proficient with AI tools in your everyday work, including for translation, writing, and research. You must be able to tell us your skill level and give real examples.

- Resourceful. You work out how to get things done without being told how, and small obstacles do not stop you. You try more than one approach before asking for help, and when you do ask, you bring a proposed solution.

- At least 5 years of experience in executive assistant, operations, or operations management roles, with a track record of independently owning and running key processes or functions without close supervision

- Fast learner who picks up new tools and processes quickly

- Able to juggle many tasks at once and coordinate multiple people without dropping details

- Strong written communication, and able to document processes clearly

- Comfortable with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Gmail, Calendar, Drive)

- Comfortable on the phone and willing to learn WeChat

- Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, a computer, and a headset, with a backup plan for power or internet outages

- Available during the coverage hours listed below



NICE TO HAVES

- Experience working overnight shifts and weekend shifts

- Any Mandarin ability (a bonus, not a requirement)

- Experience in education, tutoring, or a service business

- Experience with bilingual or Chinese-language customer support

- Experience building SOPs or training materials



SCHEDULE

- Full-time engagement, about 8 billable hours per day

- 12:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. Toronto time (hours follow Toronto's clock, including daylight saving changes), with a one-hour unpaid break

- Flexible off days during weekdays. Weekends Eastern Time are busy and are mandatory work days.

- This is an overnight shift in the Philippines, so please only apply if this works for you long term



TOOLS YOU WILL USE

Our phone system, WeChat, our custom scheduling software, and Google Workspace. We will train you on everything except Google Workspace, which you should already know.



COMPENSATION

- Monthly rate of CAD $2,000 to $2,500 (CANADIAN dollars, not US dollars)

- Where you land in this range depends on how much ownership you have taken in past roles and how much you can contribute without intervention or supervision. The more independently you can run key parts of operations, the higher the pay.

- Paid monthly through Wise, at the beginning of the following month for the full previous calendar month

- A 13th month payment after one full year of working together



ENGAGEMENT TYPE

This is an independent contractor engagement under a written service agreement. You are responsible for your own taxes and registrations, you provide your own computer, headset, and internet, and you send a simple invoice each month.



You will have access to student and family information, so confidentiality and careful handling of that data are required and covered in the agreement.



HOW TO APPLY

To be considered, please send all of the following. Applications without these will not be reviewed.



1. Your resume, showing your years of experience and the responsibilities you owned, and a short note on why you fit this role

2. A Loom video (or any video hosting link) in which you: introduce yourself in English; describe your comfort level with AI tools (beginner, intermediate, or advanced), the tools you use, and one specific time AI dramatically increased your efficiency at work; describe the biggest area of responsibility you have owned independently in a past role and the results you delivered, plus a time you hit a roadblock and worked it out on your own; and confirm you can work 12:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. Toronto time, including weekends.

3. Your expected monthly rate in Canadian or US dollars



Start your application with the word "Scholar" so we know you read the whole post.



HIRING PROCESS

2. Stage 2, practical 10-minute task

3. Stage 3, live interview: the top candidates have a video interview in English
