title: Experienced Appointment Setter – Life Insurance
description:
# Experienced Appointment Setter – Life Insurance (Remote)





This is a high-volume outbound calling position. You'll be calling people who have previously expressed interest in life insurance, as well as new leads coming in daily through our live lead campaigns.



We specialize in:

- **Indexed Universal Life (IUL) Insurance**

- **Mortgage Protection Life Insurance**



Your job is to contact prospects, build rapport, overcome objections, and book qualified appointments for a licensed insurance agent to close.



### Responsibilities



- Make **500+ outbound calls per day**, depending on lead availability, using PhoneBurner.

- Contact both fresh leads from active campaigns and older leads already in our pipeline.

- Confidently handle objections and turn hesitant prospects into booked appointments.

- Qualify prospects, confirm their interest, and schedule appointments accurately.

- Monitor *
 and Google Sheets** for incoming leads.

- Independently organize and export leads from Google Sheets into PhoneBurner.

- Manage callbacks, follow-ups, and appointment confirmations.

- Keep accurate notes and update lead dispositions after every conversation.

- Work efficiently and consistently throughout your scheduled shift.

- All calls will be recorded through PhoneBurner for quality assurance and performance review.



### Requirements



- **EXCELLENT spoken English is NON-NEGOTIABLE.** You must speak clearly, naturally, confidently, and be easily understood by American prospects.

- Previous experience in outbound appointment setting, preferably life insurance

- Strong objection-handling and conversational sales skills.

- Comfortable making hundreds of dialing attempts per day

- Experience using CRM systems, power dialers, Google Sheets, and
.

- Ability to work independently without constant supervision.

- Reliable internet connection, quality headset, and quiet working environment.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Experience with US life insurance, IUL, mortgage protection, or financial services is a major advantage.



**This is NOT a position for someone who is uncomfortable making a high volume of calls or handling rejection.** We need someone who is confident on the phone, persistent, coachable, and focused on booking appointments that actually show up.



### How to Apply



To be considered, you **MUST submit the following:**



1. **A 60–90 second voice recording in English** introducing yourself, describing your appointment-setting experience, and explaining how you would handle a prospect who says, "I'm not interested."

2. Your previous appointment-setting or outbound sales experience, including industries you've worked in.

3. The average number of outbound calls you have made per day in previous roles.

4. Your experience with PhoneBurner or other power dialers.

5. **Your expected hourly rate in USD.**

6. Your availability to work during US business hours.



**Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.**



We're looking for someone who can communicate naturally with American prospects, take ownership of the lead pipeline, and consistently produce qualified appointments.



**If you're an experienced, confident closer of conversations who knows how to turn objections into appointments, we'd like to hear from you.**

title: Acquisitions Agent — Land Flipping / Wholesaling (Work From Home)
description:
GM Capital buys vacant land in the USA. We are looking for a hardworking acquisitions agent to call land sellers, follow up, and get purchase contracts signed. You will make a lot of calls every day, working through the CRM, nurturing leads, following up with sellers, and comping lots. 

We are looking for a hardworking, disciplined person who stays focused and consistent every shift.What we do is pretty straightforward. It is a volume game: we buy land at a discounted price, so your job is to get a lot of fair, discounted offers out to sellers every day and follow up until they sign. There is not a lot of hard negotiating — the process is simple, the numbers are set, and success comes from volume and follow-up, not from long, complicated deals.

This is a long-term job. We will train you on our system, our scripts, and our tools.



What You Will Do:

Work in our CRM every day and keep all leads organized and updated

Make a lot of calls every day to land sellers in the CRM, and follow up by phone and text

Talk with sellers, learn why they want to sell, and agree on a price

Send purchase contracts to sellers and follow up until the contract is signed

Nurture each lead — do not give up after one call. Most deals need many follow-ups

Comp lots (check land prices) using Zillow, DealMachine, and Land Portal

Write clear notes in the CRM after every call

Send a short report at the end of every shift: calls made, contracts sent, contracts signed, hot leads



What You Need:

Land flipping or real estate wholesaling experience is preferred, but it is not required — we will train the right person. If you do have this experience, please tell us about it, it will help your application

Experience calling U.S. property owners / sellers is also a plus

Very good spoken English — sellers must understand you easily on the phone

Hardworking and disciplined — focused, consistent, honest, and on time every day, and you keep working your leads even when sellers say no

Good internet, a quiet place to work, and a good headset

Basic computer skills and fast learning with new software



Hours and Pay:

6 hours per day

2:00 PM – 8:00 PM Eastern Time (New York time) — you must work these hours

$6 USD per hour + commission on deals that close

Paid training



Apply now — we want to hire fast.



Software We Use

It is ideal if you already know how to use these tools. If you know some of them, please tell us which ones. We will train you on the rest.

Podio — our CRM. All leads live here, and you will update it every day

Smarter Contact — our texting platform, for sending and replying to seller texts

DealMachine — for finding properties, building lists, and owner contact info

Land Portal — for checking lots: value, flood zone, wetlands, and slope

Zillow — for checking sold prices and comping lots

# Social Media & AI Virtual Assistant (Part-Time, 20 Hours/Week)



**Creative Thinker | AI-Savvy | Strong English | US Eastern Time**



We're looking for a creative, proactive, and tech-savvy Social Media Virtual Assistant to join our growing video marketing company.



We work with entrepreneurs, coaches, consultants, speakers, and professional service businesses to help them get more visible, build authority, and attract clients through video and social media.



We create a LOT of content, and we need someone who can help us turn that content into a consistent, engaging social media presence for both our company and our clients.



**We're not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions. We're looking for someone who brings ideas, takes initiative, and enjoys being part of a creative team.**



 What You'll Be Doing



- Managing and scheduling social media content across
, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other platforms as needed.

- Writing compelling captions, hooks, and social media posts that sound natural and engaging.

- Working with our video production team to turn existing video content into social media campaigns.

- Helping organize and manage multiple client social media accounts.

- Using AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT to brainstorm content, improve workflows, and work more efficiently.

- Collaborating with our editors and team members to keep content moving from production to publication.

### What We're Looking For



**Excellent English communication skills.** You must be an excellent English writer and a confident verbal communicator. You'll be writing for US-based businesses, so understanding natural American English is essential.



**AI-forward mindset.** You should already be comfortable using AI tools, especially Claude and ChatGPT, and be genuinely excited about learning how to use AI to do better, more creative work. We're looking for someone who thinks beyond basic prompting.



**Social media experience.** You should understand how content works across different platforms, including what makes a good hook, caption, short-form video, and engaging post.



**Creativity and initiative.** We want your ideas! If you see an opportunity to improve something, speak up. If you have a better way to do something, we'd love to hear it.



**Organization and attention to detail.** You'll be working with multiple projects and accounts, so keeping things organized, accurate, and on schedule is important.



**Strong teamwork.** You'll be collaborating with a small, friendly, hardworking team. Communication, reliability, and a positive attitude matter.



**Reliable technology.** You must have a dependable computer, excellent high-speed internet, and a professional environment for video meetings.



### Bonus Skills (Not Required)



- Experience with GoHighLevel, especially its Social Planner and sub-account management.

- Experience managing social media for multiple clients or agencies.

- Familiarity with video marketing and content repurposing.

- Experience creating AI-assisted content workflows or automations.



Don't worry if you don't know GoHighLevel yet. We're happy to train the right person.

**Hours:** Approximately 20 hours per week to start, with the opportunity to grow.



**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, approximately 4 hours per day, with availability during US Eastern Time business hours.



**Location:** Remote, Philippines.



We're looking for someone interested in building a long-term relationship with our company. As we grow, there's potential for additional hours, responsibilities, and opportunities.

We're excited to find someone who loves social media, enjoys technology, and wants to help us build something great together!

title: Experienced E-commerce Customer Service VA – Fashion, Customer Communication,
description:
# Hiring: Experienced Shopify Customer Service Representative – Fashion E-commerce



**Industry:** E-commerce / Fashion (US Market)  

**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Experience:** Previous Shopify and e-commerce customer support experience required



## Important – Please Read Before Applying



We are looking for a **highly experienced e-commerce Customer Service Representative** who has previously worked with Shopify stores and understands how to handle high volumes of customer support tickets efficiently.



**Our biggest priorities are:**



- **Chargeback Prevention:** Proven experience in reducing chargebacks, resolving disputes before they escalate, and handling dissatisfied customers.

- **Refunds, Returns & Store Credit:** Experience negotiating and offering appropriate partial refunds, store credit, exchanges, and returns to resolve customer issues while protecting the business.

- **High-Volume Ticket Management:** Ability to respond to a large number of daily tickets quickly, accurately, and professionally.

- **Shopify Experience:** Strong knowledge of Shopify, including order management, tracking, refunds, cancellations, and customer information.

- **Attention to Detail & Documentation:** Every customer interaction, action taken, and unresolved issue must be properly logged and followed up on.

- **Supplier Communication:** Experience communicating with suppliers regarding out-of-stock products, shipping delays, fulfillment issues, and refunds.

- **Speed & Efficiency:** Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and keep up as the business continues growing.



**We are specifically looking for someone with previous hands-on experience in these areas, not someone who needs to learn the basics of e-commerce customer support.**



## About Us



We are a growing e-commerce business operating **multiple online fashion stores selling clothing and fashion products to customers across the United States.**



Our business is expanding every day, with increasing order volumes and customer inquiries across our stores.



We see customer service as one of the most important parts of our business operations. It is not simply about responding to
s. Good customer service directly impacts customer satisfaction, chargeback rates, profitability, and the overall success of our stores.



We are looking for someone who understands this responsibility and wants to become a valuable part of our team.



As we continue to grow, we want to build a reliable team of people who take their work seriously, care about the business, and want to grow alongside us.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Customer Support & Ticket Management

- Handle a high volume of daily customer inquiries across multiple fashion stores.

- Respond to questions regarding orders, shipping, product issues, cancellations, returns, and refunds.

- Provide clear, professional, and helpful responses to US customers.

- Work quickly while maintaining a high standard of accuracy.

- Keep detailed logs of all customer interactions, resolutions, and required follow-ups.

- Ensure unresolved tickets are properly tracked and nothing is overlooked.



### 2. Chargeback Prevention & Refund Management



**This is one of the most important responsibilities of the position.**



- Proactively resolve customer complaints before they turn into chargebacks or payment disputes.

- Understand how to handle frustrated customers and de-escalate difficult situations.

- Have previous experience offering partial refunds, store credit, exchanges, or returns as appropriate solutions.

- Know when to offer alternative resolutions and when a full refund is required under company policies and applicable customer rights.

- Work toward reducing unnecessary chargebacks and financial losses while keeping customers satisfied.

- Recognize potential dispute risks and take action early.



### 3. Shopify Order Management

- Navigate Shopify confidently and independently.

- Review order details, fulfillment statuses, tracking information, refunds, and cancellations.

- Investigate order issues and provide accurate customer updates.

- Maintain organized customer and order records.

- Work across multiple Shopify stores when needed.



### 4. Supplier Communication

- Communicate with suppliers regarding order delays, missing items, stock availability, and fulfillment problems.

- Follow up on orders that require additional attention.

- Identify out-of-stock products and coordinate cancellations, alternatives, or refunds.

- Ensure customers are informed promptly and accurately when issues arise.

- Maintain clear communication between customers, suppliers, and the internal team.



## Requirements



- Proven experience working in customer service for e-commerce businesses, preferably fashion or clothing stores.

- Strong hands-on experience with Shopify.

- Previous experience handling a high volume of customer support tickets daily.

- **Strong understanding of chargeback prevention, refund negotiations, partial refunds, store credit, and returns.**

- Excellent written English and professional communication skills.

- Extremely detail-oriented and organized.

- Ability to work quickly and efficiently without sacrificing quality.

- Previous experience communicating with suppliers and resolving fulfillment issues.

- Good problem-solving skills and the ability to make informed decisions.

- Ability to maintain accurate logs and follow up on unresolved cases.

- Reliable, responsible, and capable of working independently.



## The Type of Person We're Looking For



Experience is extremely important to us, but so is your attitude toward your work.



We want someone who:



- **Genuinely cares about the work they do** and takes pride in delivering good results.

- Understands that customer service is a vital part of the business, not just a task of replying to
s.

- Is a team player who communicates well and supports the rest of the operation.

- Takes ownership of customer issues and follows through until they are resolved.

- Pays close attention to details and understands how small mistakes can affect the business.

- Can adapt quickly, work at a fast pace, and handle increasing responsibilities.

- Is proactive and identifies problems before they become bigger issues.

- Wants to build a long-term working relationship and grow with the company.



We are growing quickly and value people who can keep up with that growth while maintaining high standards.



## Long-Term Growth Opportunity



We are not simply looking to fill a temporary position.



We want to find someone who can become a **long-term, valuable member of our team** and play an important role in our daily operations.



As our business expands and we continue adding more stores, there will be opportunities to take on greater responsibilities and potentially move into customer service leadership or management positions.



We want someone who feels invested in the company's success and understands that their contribution genuinely matters.



## How to Apply



Please include the following information in your application:



1. **Your previous e-commerce customer service experience**, including what types of stores you worked for.

2. Your experience using Shopify and any customer support platforms.

3. **Your experience reducing chargebacks and handling partial refunds, store credit, and returns.** Please provide an example of how you successfully resolved a difficult customer situation.

4. Approximately how many customer support tickets you have handled per day in previous roles.

5. Your experience communicating with suppliers and handling shipping or stock-related issues.

6. Your expected hourly rate in USD and your availability.



**Please note:** We are prioritizing candidates with genuine, hands-on e-commerce customer support experience. Generic applications that do not address the requirements above will not be prioritized.



We look forward to finding someone who is experienced, motivated, detail-oriented, and ready to grow with our business.

K-I Machine is a CNC machine shop in Illinois, USA, making precision parts, including for the medical industry. We’re moving from year-end bookkeeping to clean monthly books, and we need a reliable bookkeeper to own that long-term.



What you’ll do



Catch up our 2026 books: enter and categorize January–October in QuickBooks Online from our bank and credit card records, and reconcile every month. Target: complete by mid-January.

Ongoing monthly bookkeeping: enter vendor bills, categorize transactions, create customer invoices, follow up on unpaid invoices, reconcile accounts and prepare month-end reports.

Year-end support: collect W-9s and prepare the 1099 list for our CPA.

Connect our in-house software to QuickBooks: d
 how our jobs, invoices and bills should flow into QuickBooks, write clear change requests (our AI tool does the coding), and test everything in a QuickBooks sandbox.



You’ll work with our in-house accountant, who approves and pays, and our CPA, who handles taxes and quarterly reviews. You will have your own QuickBooks login. You won’t have payment authority.



Requirements



2+ years of QuickBooks Online bookkeeping for US businesses

Experience with catch-up or cleanup projects

QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification preferred

title: Quality Assurance Specialist – (Remote PH)
description:
Company Overview



The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.



MedPro Disposal is the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company, serving 35,000+ healthcare providers across 48 states for the past 15 years. On that foundation, we launched MP1 Solutions to pioneer the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined healthcare compliance for decades. MP1 Solutions extends MedPro Disposal's operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading — with a technology-forward approach that's making this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that, backed by 15 years of MedPro Disposal's operational credibility — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.



Position Overview:

MedPro is growing, and every new client, service agreement and hire adds more work that has to be done right the first time. The Quality Assurance Specialist is the check on that work. You will audit core operational output, find where errors start, and drive fixes so mistakes stop reaching clients. Success means a high, steady accuracy rate across Salesforce records, service agreements and client communication, with repeat errors falling every quarter.

Please note: this is an operations and process audit role, not a software testing role.



Key Responsibilities:

Auditing & Quality Monitoring

• Audit core operational work every week using standard QA scorecards, including Salesforce record accuracy, service agreement requests and client-facing
s

• Build and maintain QA scorecards and audit criteria for each core process, aligned with the steps in MedPro's SOPs

• Track accuracy and error rates by process and by team member, and keep the QA log current and audit-ready



Feedback & Root-Cause Analysis

• Deliver clear, documented QA feedback to team members and their managers within the agreed turnaround

• Analyze error trends to find root causes: SOP gaps, system issues or individual performance

• Flag SOPs that are outdated or unclear, and work with process owners to get them corrected



Reporting & Continuous Improvement

• Report monthly QA results and trends to leadership, with recommended fixes

• Verify that corrective actions worked by re-auditing the affected processes and confirming the error rates dropped



Required Qualifications:

• 2+ years of experience in quality assurance, auditing or operations in a process-heavy role

Technical Skills:

Nice-to-Have:

• Background in medical waste, environmental services, or OSHA/HIPAA compliance

• Experience building QA scorecards or an audit program from scratch

• Lean or Six Sigma training (Yellow or Green Belt)

• Strong Excel skills: pivot tables and charts for trend analysis

title: SharePoint Developer
description:
About Our Company



Nationwide Sports Construction is a growing U.S.-based sports construction company specializing in synthetic turf athletic fields, sports complexes, and civil construction projects throughout the United States.



We are looking for an experienced Microsoft 365 SharePoint Developer & AI Automation Specialist to help us modernize how our company stores, organizes, secures, and utilizes information.



This is not simply a data entry or file migration position. We need someone who can design, build, and maintain a scalable cloud-based document management system that will support our company as we continue to grow.



Our goal is to transition from traditional server-based file storage to a centralized Microsoft 365 SharePoint environment, while incorporating artificial intelligence to make our company information more accessible and useful.  We have tried, but as we've grown in the past two years, seems like our separate departments are doing their own thing in SharePoint, isolated from each other.



Primary Responsibilities



1. SharePoint Architecture & Development



Design and implement a company-wide Microsoft SharePoint Online environment.

Create organized SharePoint sites, document libraries, folders, and workflows for our various departments.

Establish a clean, logical, scalable document management structure.

Work directly with our department leaders to understand their file storage needs and business processes.

Develop consistent file naming conventions, document organization standards, and metadata structures.

Ensure SharePoint integrates effectively with Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, Outlook, and other Microsoft 365 applications.



Our departments include:

Executive Leadership

Accounting & Finance

Preconstruction & Estimating

Operations & Project Management

Sales & Business Development

Marketing

Equipment & Fleet Management



2. Data Migration & Organization



We currently have years of historical company information stored on our internal server.



Responsibilities include:

Assist with migrating historical files and documents from our existing server into SharePoint Online.

Evaluate and organize existing data before migration.

Identify duplicate, outdated, or unnecessary files.

Develop a logical organizational structure for historical and active construction projects.

Ensure documents remain searchable, accessible, and properly categorized.

Preserve historical project information for future reference.



3. Security & Permission Management

Data security is extremely important to our company.



The successful candidate will:

Establish department-specific access permissions.

Restrict confidential accountin, and Executive information to authorized employees.

Configure SharePoint security groups and role-based permissions.

Ensure employees can access the information they need without accessing confidential information from other departments.

Implement secure document-sharing practices.

Follow Microsoft 365 security best practices.



4. AI Integration – Claude & Document Automation



One of our most important long-term goals is integrating artificial intelligence into our company knowledge base.

We want employees to be able to use Claude AI (Anthropic) to search our historical company information, retrieve relevant documents, and automatically generate new content.



Example Use Case:



Our Marketing Manager receives a request to prepare a proposal for a potential project involving the construction of three synthetic turf soccer fields in Kentucky.



Ideally, she could ask Claude:

"Create a proposal for this Kentucky soccer field project using our company proposal template. Include relevant photographs, descriptions, and examples of similar synthetic turf soccer field projects we have completed in Kentucky or nearby states."



The AI system would then:

Search our historical SharePoint project files.

Identify relevant completed projects.

Retrieve approved project photographs and descriptions.

Populate our standardized company proposal template.

Generate an editable Microsoft Word document for our Marketing Manager to review and finalize.



We understand this functionality may require additional development, API integrations, Microsoft Power Automate, or other AI tools.



We are looking for someone who understands how to build this type of solution or has the technical ability to research, develop, and implement it.



Additional potential AI applications include:



Searching historical construction project documents.

Finding past proposals, estimates, and project information.

Generating marketing materials from existing company content.

Retrieving project photographs and completed project references.

Automating repetitive document creation.



Helping department leaders find information quickly without manually searching through hundreds of folders.



Important: AI access must respect our established SharePoint security permissions. Employees should never be able to retrieve confidential information they are not authorized to access.





Required Qualifications



Strong experience with Microsoft SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365.

Proven experience designing and implementing SharePoint document management systems.

Experience with SharePoint permissions, security groups, and access controls.

Experience migrating files from traditional servers to SharePoint.

Strong knowledge of Microsoft Power Automate.

Understanding of Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, and Microsoft 365 integrations.

Ability to develop scalable document organization systems.

Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Ability to work independently and collaborate with U.S.-based department leaders.

Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience integrating Claude AI, Anthropic APIs, or other LLM platforms with business systems.

Knowledge of AI-powered document search and retrieval (RAG).

Experience automating Microsoft Word templates and proposal generation.

Experience with construction companies, project management, or professional services organizations.

Experience building document management systems for growing businesses.



What Success Looks Like



We want to hire someone who can take ownership of this initiative and help us accomplish the following:



Phase 1 – Planning & Architecture

Meet with company leadership, understand our existing file structure, and design a comprehensive SharePoint environment.



Phase 2 – SharePoint Implementation

Build our company SharePoint sites, establish department permissions, and implement a scalable document management structure.



Phase 3 – Data Migration

Organize and migrate our historical server files into SharePoint while maintaining security and accessibility.



Phase 4 – AI Integration

Develop a secure connection between SharePoint and Claude AI (or another approved AI solution) to allow employees to search company information and automate document generation.



Phase 5 – Training & Optimization

Train employees, document procedures, and continue improving our systems and workflows.



How to Apply



Please include the following information with your application:

Include the sentence "Sports Construction is fun!"

Describe your experience building SharePoint Online environments for businesses.

Have you migrated files from an on-premises server to SharePoint? Please explain.

Have you implemented department-specific security permissions in SharePoint?

Have you integrated Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, or another AI platform with SharePoint or Microsoft 365?

Describe a document automation or AI integration project you have completed.

What would your recommended approach be for building the system described in this job posting?

Please provide examples of relevant projects or a portfolio of your previous work.

We are looking for a technically skilled, detail-oriented professional who can help build a long-term technology foundation for our growing company.

title: Personal Creative & Wellness Assistant: For Someone Who Already Lives These Interests (Remote, Long-Term)
description:
This is not a typical VA job. Please read every word. The application is designed so the right person will enjoy it and everyone else will find it too much trouble.



I'm a mature, established CEO. My business is fully staffed, and this role has nothing to do with it. This is about my personal life: my writing, travel, and personal growth. I'm looking for one emotionally grounded, dependable person to support that over the long term.



What You'll Help With



• Writing: Brainstorming, researching, and editing my published romance articles, with honest feedback.



• Travel and hiking: Researching destinations and trails, planning itineraries, and handling bookings.



• Meditation and yoga: Finding and comparing retreats, including ones rooted in Eastern contemplative and tantric philosophy traditions.



• Personal growth: Supporting my self-help book clubs with reading lists, discussion questions, and scheduling.



I don't expect you to love all of these. No one genuinely does. I'd much rather hear about the one or two that are truly part of your life than hear that you're passionate about everything.



Who You Are



• Emotionally mature, calm, and honest



• Loyal and reliable: you follow through without reminders



• Discreet and trustworthy with personal matters



• A strong English writer who is comfortable discussing romance and relationships professionally



• Any age; life experience is welcome



Terms



Remote, about 10 hours/week, long-term, starting with a paid 30-day trial. Compensation is fair and will be discussed personally with candidates I invite to interview. Since alignment comes first for me, I'd ask that you focus your application on who you are rather than on rates.



Please don't send a resume. Your work history matters less to me than who you are. Send the items below instead.



How to Apply



1. Subject line: "Aligned: [your first name] - [the ONE interest closest to your heart]"



2. Pick one or two interests and tell me how each shows up in your life right now. Give me real details: which trail, which book, how long you've practiced, what you write about. I'll recognize general statements.



3. Tell me which interest on my list you connect with LEAST, and why. Honesty here counts in your favor.



4. Name a book that changed you and describe one specific moment when it made a difference in your life.



5. Writing sample: Send
words of something personal and unpolished: a journal entry, a memory, or a reflection. I value your own voice far more than perfect grammar. Please don't send anything written for clients or employers.



6. A 2-minute voice recording introducing yourself and talking about the interest you named in your subject line. Just speak naturally; no script needed.



7. One question you'd ask me about my writing, travel, or practice. Please leave out questions about pay, hours, or benefits. We'll cover those together in the interview.



Please write in your own words. I can tell when answers were written with AI or repeat the wording of this post, and those applications won't be considered.



I look forward to hearing from the right person.

title: Appointment Setter | WFH | UK Estate Agency
description:
Remote | Long-Term Career Growth | Outbound Calls and Appointment Setting

Full-time | 40 Hours per Week | PHP 290 to 330 per Hour starting | Bi-Weekly Pay | Performance Bonuses



Luxury Hub and Pure Green are fast-growing UK-based property companies managing over £20m in assets and securing £30m in investment funding for future developments.



Luxury Hub is an estate and letting agency covering Manchester, Stockport, Lancashire and the wider North West of England. We have a large database of homeowners, landlords and tenants who have already enquired with us, and we are expanding into new areas.



We are expanding our Philippines-based team and are hiring an Appointment Setter with estate agency experience. Your job is to call the people who have enquired with us, find out where they are in their moving journey, and book them in with our UK team.



This is a phone heavy role. You will make 50 to 60 outbound calls a day. If you know the property world, love being on the phone and get a buzz from a full diary, this role is for you.



WHY JOIN US



• Work remotely for a stable UK-based company

• Long-term role with guaranteed hours and job security

• Warm leads: you will be calling people who have already enquired with us

• Gain experience of the UK property market, sales and lettings

• Work closely with senior leadership and our UK valuers

• Training on our systems, scripts and local areas

• Clear progression as the business grows

• Annual performance review with potential pay increase



OUR CULTURE AND VALUES



At Luxury Hub, culture matters. We are building a long term team, not short term contractors.



• Shared Vision – Aligning personal ambition with company success and shared goals

• Virtue and Talents – Individual talents are recognised and nurtured

• Continuous Improvement – We welcome feedback, stay curious, innovate and improve

• Focused Contribution – We play to our strengths and passions to create real impact

• Meaningful Partnerships – We believe in mutual value creation and growing together



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Sales Valuations

• Call homeowners and landlords who requested an online valuation or contacted us through our website and lead providers

• Book in person valuations with our UK valuers

• Re-engage older leads with a clear, friendly script and find out who is ready to move



Lettings

• Call tenants and applicants to book property viewings

• Collect viewing feedback and move interested applicants towards an application

• Support the lettings team with follow up calls when needed



CRM and Diary Management

• Log every call, outcome and note in our CRM (
)

• Set follow up reminders for people who are not ready yet, for example "call me back in six months"

• Coordinate diaries with our UK valuers and viewing agents



Targets and Reporting

• Hit daily call targets and weekly booked appointment targets

• Share call outcomes and feedback to help improve our scripts and lead sources



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You should have:



• At least 1 year of experience calling for an estate agency, letting agency or real estate business (UK experience strongly preferred; US, Australian or Canadian real estate also considered)

• Proven appointment-setting results you can tell us about: calls per day and appointments booked

• Excellent spoken English, clear and confident on the phone

• Comfortable with rejection and with handling objections in real time

• Good understanding of how property sales and lettings work: valuations, viewings, landlords, tenants and applicants

• Experience using a CRM and a VoIP dialler

• Accurate, organised note-taking

• Quiet workspace, noise-cancelling headset, reliable internet with a backup connection and power backup

• Availability to work UK hours, including some Saturdays

• No other full-time job or full-time study commitments



COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS



Competitive Pay and Bonuses

• PHP 290 to 330 per hour starting rate, based on experience

• Biweekly pay

• Annual performance and pay review

• Appointment bonus for booked appointments that go ahead, available after 12 months of service and subject to agreed KPIs



Bonuses and Incentives

• Thirteenth month pay

• Fourteenth month performance bonus after five years of service

• Bonus days off every 80 hours worked after probation



Long-Term Growth and Stability

• Paid training and career development

• Health stipend after two years of service

• Company loan options after two years of service

• Guaranteed pay security: if we do not provide enough work, you will still be paid for at least 75 percent of your contracted hours



HOW TO APPLY



• Complete this short application form:

• Only applications made through the Google Form will be accepted. Applications sent only through OnlineJobs.ph will not be reviewed.

• The form includes a short voice recording. Applications without the recording will not be reviewed.

• No CV required at this stage.



HIRING TIMELINE



The job posting will close on 13th December 2026 at 11:59 PM UK time. We will review the applications received over the following days and let applicants know the results by 18th December.



Shortlisted candidates will then receive an invite to complete a trial task, due in the first week of January. For candidates who advance, interviews will take place in the 2nd or 3rd week of January. We aim to make a final decision by the end of January, and the successful candidate will begin in the 1st or 2nd week of February.



Note: This timeline may adjust slightly as we progress, especially around the Christmas holidays. We'll keep you informed.



Thank you for your patience and enthusiasm. Join us and grow your career with a UK based estate agency.

title: QuickBooks Online Bookkeeper – Real Estate Investment Company
description:
I am seeking an experienced, dependable Virtual Assistant to handle bookkeeping for a small real estate investment company. Applicants must have at least 2 years of hands-on professional experience with QuickBooks Online.

This is an ongoing, part-time gig position. During the initial phase, you should expect approximately 2 hours of work per day as we organize and clean up the existing books. Once everything is up to date and properly organized, the workload is expected to decrease to approximately 1 hour per day.



I am looking for someone who is trustworthy, organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking responsibility for maintaining accurate financial records.



Job Responsibilities

1. QuickBooks Online Bookkeeping

     Maintain the company's financial records in QuickBooks Online.

     Properly categorize income, expenses, and other transactions.

     Reconcile bank accounts and credit card statements.

     Review transactions for accuracy and correct classification.

     Find and correct duplicate, uncategorized, or incorrectly classified transactions.

     Maintain organized bookkeeping records for a small real estate portfolio.

    Assist with monthly financial reviews and reporting.



2. QuickBooks Cleanup and Organization 

Our existing QuickBooks company file has accumulated several inactive, dormant, and potentially unnecessary accounts. One of your first priorities will be to review and improve the current bookkeeping setup.

This will include:

     Reviewing the existing Chart of Accounts.

     Identifying duplicate, inactive, dormant, or unnecessary accounts.

     Recommending which accounts should be retained, consolidated, or deactivated.

     Reviewing and correcting transaction classifications when appropriate.

     Improving the overall organization of the books.

     Establishing a clean, manageable bookkeeping system going forward.

     Important: You must be comfortable inheriting an existing QuickBooks file that needs attention, organization, and cleanup.



3. Communication and Accountability

     Send a brief daily activity report summarizing completed work, hours worked, and any outstanding issues.

     Attend a scheduled one-hour weekly meeting with the owner to discuss progress, questions, and priorities.

     Communicate promptly when clarification or approval is needed.

     Bring unusual transactions, discrepancies, and potential problems to the owner's attention rather than guessing or making     unauthorized changes.



Hours and Compensation

    Hourly Rate: $6 USD.

    Initial Workload: Approximately 2 hours per day.

   Ongoing Workload: Approximately 1 hour per day after the initial cleanup.

   Weekly Meeting: One hour with the owner.

   Position Type: Ongoing, part-time gig work.

   Growth Potential: Opportunity for continued work for someone who performs well. 



Actual hours may fluctuate depending on the amount of bookkeeping work and the progress of the initial cleanup.

    Time Tracking and Payment

    Payments will be made through Sendwave.

   You will be required to use a time-tracking application to record all working hours.

   Accurate time tracking is mandatory.

   A daily activity report must accompany your work.



Required Qualifications

   Applicants must meet the following requirements:

   Minimum of 2 years of professional QuickBooks Online experience.

   Previous real estate bookkeeping experience is preferred.

   Strong understanding of basic bookkeeping and accounting principles.

   Experience reconciling bank and credit card accounts.

   Experience categorizing financial transactions.

   Ability to review and organize an existing QuickBooks company file.

   Excellent attention to detail and organizational abilities.

   Good written and spoken English.

   Reliable internet connection and a suitable computer.

   Ability to participate in a weekly one-hour meeting with the owner.

   Ability to work independently, meet expectations, and provide consistent daily updates.



How to Apply

To be considered, please include ALL of the following in your application:

   1. QuickBooks Online Experience

      Explain your bookkeeping background and specify exactly how many years you have worked professionally with                                 QuickBooks Online.

2. Relevant Bookkeeping Skills

Describe your experience with:

    Bank and credit card reconciliations.

   Categorizing income and expenses.

   Reviewing and correcting transaction classifications.

   Cleaning up and organizing an existing QuickBooks company file.

3. Resume

   Provide a link to your current resume (Google Drive or another accessible link).

4. Additional Experience

   Include any previous property management or residential leasing experience. Bonus points if you have worked with a real    estate investment company.

5. Availability

   Confirm that you can initially commit to approximately 2 hours per day and attend a weekly one-hour meeting with the owner.

6. Equipment and Internet

   Confirm that you have a reliable internet connection and a computer suitable for professional bookkeeping work.

7. Favorite Filipino Celebrity

Final Application Instructions

Use 4 Application Points when submitting your application.

Professional communication

Additional performance incentives every month

Performance

title: Pricing and Promotions Analyst
description:
Company: Cosmo Appliances



POSITION OVERVIEW



The Sales Promotions and Pricing Analyst supports the planning, preparation, and submission of promotional campaigns across multiple sales channels. This role is responsible for ensuring promotions are submitted correctly, tracked, and confirmed before deadlines.



The position requires strong organizational skills, advanced Excel proficiency, and consistent follow-through. The assistant will work closely with management and internal teams to gather required data for promotions and ensure all information is accurate before submission.



This role requires a high level of responsibility and accountability, as promotions must be monitored and followed up on until they are fully confirmed and scheduled.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Promotion Submission & Tracking

• Prepare and submit promotional requests across sales channels and retailer portals.

• Maintain organized records of all promotion submissions, approvals, and campaign details.

• Track promotions from submission through confirmation to ensure they are properly scheduled.

• Follow up with partners or internal teams until promotions are fully confirmed.



Follow-Up & Coordination

• Follow up with management and relevant departments to gather all required data needed for promotion submissions.

• Ensure promotional details such as pricing, product lists, discount structures, and campaign dates are complete before deadlines.

• Monitor upcoming promotional deadlines and proactively communicate missing information.



Data Management & Excel Responsibilities

• Use advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills to perform calculations related to promotional pricing, margins, discounts, and campaign planning.

• Create and maintain spreadsheets used for tracking promotions, pricing adjustments, and campaign performance.

• Review calculations and verify promotional data accuracy before submissions are made.



Accountability & Process Ownership

• Take ownership of assigned promotional campaigns and ensure they are completed accurately and on time.

• Maintain clear tracking of pending submissions and follow up regularly until confirmations are received.

• Communicate status updates to management regarding promotion approvals and outstanding items.



Accuracy & Issue Resolution

• Maintain a high level of attention to detail when preparing promotional submissions and calculations.

• If mistakes occur, take responsibility for identifying the issue and correcting it promptly.

• Work proactively to investigate discrepancies and ensure errors are resolved quickly and properly.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



• 3-5 years of experience in marketing, promotions, pricing analysis and pricing management, sales support, or administrative coordination preferred.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

• Strong organizational and time-management skills.

• Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple deadlines.

• Strong communication and follow-up skills.



PREFERRED SKILLS



• Experience with retail or e-commerce promotional campaigns.

• Familiarity with retailer portals or online marketplace systems.

• Experience managing promotional calendars or campaign trackers.



KEY TRAITS



• Accountability – Takes ownership of assigned tasks and follows through until completed.

• Responsibility – Maintains accuracy and reliability when handling promotions and calculations.

• Proactive Communication – Follows up with management and teams to gather required information.

• Attention to Detail – Ensures promotional pricing and calculations are accurate.

• Organization – Maintains clear records and tracking systems for promotions.



IMPORTANT EXPECTATIONS



Promotions often involve multiple deadlines and stakeholders. The Sales Promotions Assistant must be comfortable following up with management and internal teams to gather required data and ensuring promotions are completed and confirmed on time.



Accuracy and accountability are critical in this role. If errors occur, the expectation is that the individual takes responsibility, works quickly to resolve the issue, and implements corrections to prevent repeat mistakes.

title: Sales Setter
description:
*** Please read the entire job posting to be considered*****



Elevate Marketing Solutions is hiring a **Sales Setter**  to qualify prospects, book and confirm sales appointments, and keep our sales pipeline moving. **Fluency in English and Spanish is required**, including strong written and verbal communication in both languages.



## About Elevate Marketing Solutions



We’re a digital marketing company specializing in chiropractic. We help chiropractors grow their practices, reach more patients, and improve the health of their communities. Our services include Meta Ads, Google Ads, SEO, website development, call center services, and conversational AI.



Our team lives by four values: **Integrity, Do More with Less, Win as One, and Celebrate.** We move quickly, take pride in the quality of our work, and educate our clients so we can support them as long-term partners.



## About the Role



You’ll be the first point of contact for many prospective clients. You’ll research their practices, ask questions to determine fit, and make sure qualified prospects are ready for their calls with our Business Development Representatives. You’ll also take initiative to fill open calendar slots through cold outreach, warm lead follow-up, and re-engagement.



This role offers a path to grow into sales, account management, or leadership as you build your skills and the company expands.



## What You’ll Do



- **Confirm sales appointments.** Call scheduled prospects one day before their appointments and confirm same-day bookings immediately. Send SMS and
 reminders with the Zoom link. If a prospect doesn’t answer, leave a voi
 and follow up by text.

- **Research and qualify prospects.** Review each practice’s website, Google rankings and reviews,
 ad activity, and services. Call the prospect directly when you need more information to determine fit. Share relevant notes with the sales team before the call.

- **Manage the sales calendar and inbound inquiries.** Prevent double-bookings, reschedule appointments as needed, answer incoming calls through Google Voice, and respond promptly to texts,
s, and ad-generated inquiries.

- **Follow up consistently.** Use a structured three-day sequence for no-shows, cancellations, and requested callbacks. Follow up by phone, SMS, and
, and track the next step for each prospect.

- **Keep the sales pipeline current.** Use GoHighLevel (GHL) to manage warm leads, log outreach, and keep lead statuses up to date. Pair call attempts with an SMS follow-up and leave a voi
 when the prospect doesn’t answer.

- **Drive cold and warm outreach.** Use approved call scripts, messages, and

title: Project Cost Engineer / Assistant Project Manager
description:
***** TO BE CONSIDERED AS AN APPLICANT, PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR MOST UP-TO-DATE RESUME AND A VIDEO INTRODUCTION TAILORED TO THIS JOB POSTING***** 



Project Cost Engineer / Assistant Project Manager



Job Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM Pacific Time, with a 1-hour break



Job Overview: 

We are seeking a proactive and analytical Project Cost Engineer / Assistant Project Manager with hands-on construction industry experience, preferably in architectural sheet metal, aluminum composite material (ACM) panels, exterior cladding, or building envelope systems. The ideal candidate must have experience using Sage 300 CRE and Procore to monitor project costs, track field productivity, and evaluate financial performance.



This role combines construction cost engineering with project management support, focusing on cost control, labor productivity, cost-to-complete forecasting, and early identification of potential cost overruns. The ideal candidate understands construction operations, can interpret financial and field-production data, and proactively recommends corrective actions to protect project profitability.



Key Responsibilities:

* Monitor project budgets, actual costs, purchase orders, subcontract commitments, and remaining costs for architectural sheet metal, ACM panel, exterior cladding, and building envelope projects.

* Reconcile Sage 300 CRE financial data with Procore daily reports, labor hours, installed quantities, and project progress.

* Analyze labor productivity and compare actual performance against estimated production rates to identify inefficiencies.

* Prepare realistic cost-to-complete forecasts and flag projects trending over budget before substantial losses occur.

* Review field reports for extra work, scope changes, delays, and potential change orders; organize supporting documentation for project manager review.

* Assist with purchase orders, subcontract commitments, cost coding, project documentation, and other assistant project management duties.

* Provide concise morning summaries and weekly reports highlighting budget variances, productivity concerns, outstanding issues, potential change orders, and recommended corrective actions.

* Coordinate with accounting, project managers, and field teams to investigate discrepancies and obtain missing information.

Improve reporting through Excel, automation, and appropriate AI tools, verifying accuracy against source records.



Required Skills & Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or Industrial Engineering required.

* Relevant experience in construction cost engineering, project controls, or subcontractor cost management.

* Direct experience with architectural sheet metal, ACM panels, exterior cladding, or building envelope construction strongly preferred.

* Hands-on proficiency in Sage 300 CRE, including job costing, purchase orders, commitments, and budget tracking.

* Hands-on proficiency in Procore, including daily reports, labor hours, project progress, documentation, and change orders.

* Strong understanding of construction installation methods, labor productivity, cost forecasting, and change-order documentation.

* Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup formulas, and financial reconciliations.

* Ability to read construction drawings, specifications, estimates, and scope documents; Bluebeam experience preferred.

* Proactive and analytical, with the ability to investigate discrepancies, ask informed questions, and recommend practical solutions independently.

* Strong written and spoken English.

* Availability to work 7:00 AM–4:00 PM Pacific Time.



****Applicants must clearly disclose if they lack experience with Sage 300 CRE or Procore. Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical technical assessment****



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

title: AI Systems Architect
description:
Remote · Full-time · Eastern Time Schedule . ₱100,000–₱115,000/month depending on experience + HMO + 10 days paid leave after 6 months,



About the role:



We're looking for a hands-on AI Systems Architect to design, build and run the AI foundation our whole organization will work on.



You'll shape how our teams and clients use AI agents day to day, so people spend less time on repetitive work and more time on work that matters. This is a build role, not an advisory one. You'll write production code, make the architecture calls and set the standards others build on.

If you enjoy turning messy business workflows into reliable, secure AI systems, and you care whether they actually make people's work better, we'd like to hear from you.



What you'll do:



• Design our AI architecture. Set the standards for models, agents, orchestration, memory, tools, data access and human review.

• Build AI agents that work in production. Create agents, multi-agent systems and reusable services that teams can rely on.

• D
 what AI should and shouldn't do. Choose when work belongs to an AI agent, regular software, an automated workflow or a person.

• Set up how people work with agents. Define each agent's job, tools, permissions and escalation rules, and how people assign, review and accept its work.

• Keep things secure across clients. Design a multi-client setup that keeps each client's data separate and protects confidential information.

• Measure quality. Build evaluation and testing that tracks accuracy, reliability, cost, speed and rework, and catches hallucinations and bad recommendations.

• Guard against AI-specific risks. Handle prompt injection, data leakage and unauthorized tool use, with clear audit trails and human approval where it counts.

• Turn business needs into working systems. Translate requirements into workflows, integrations and clear acceptance criteria.

• Lead and coach developers. Give direction, review work and help others build with the patterns you set.

• Solve the hard problems yourself. Stay close enough to the code to understand real effort and risk.



What you'll bring:



•5+ years of professional software engineering, including at least 2 years building AI/LLM systems used by real users or clients

• A track record of building AI agents or multi-agent systems

• Strong hands-on software engineering skills and experience with enterprise or platform architecture

• Practical experience with LLMs, structured outputs, tool calling, retrieval and orchestration

• Experience connecting AI systems to applications, databases, knowledge sources and APIs

• Experience building evaluation, testing and quality checks for AI

• Experience with authentication, permissions, audit logging and data protection

• Experience deploying, monitoring and supporting AI systems in production

• A history of turning business workflows into secure technical solutions and leading delivery

• Evidence that your work produced measurable improvements in operations, productivity or revenue

We don't require any particular framework, model provider or vendor. We care that you choose tools based on security, reliability, cost and business need.



Nice to have:



• A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

• Experience with multi-client or multi-tenant platforms

• Experience building reusable AI products or platform capabilities

• Experience with knowledge architecture, semantic systems or advanced retrieval

• Experience in a growing company where systems and standards are still taking shape



How you work:



• You think in systems and enjoy rolling up your sleeves to solve problems.

• You're open about your assumptions and blind spots, and you make uncertainty visible.

• You're comfortable making progress with incomplete information.

• You explain technical ideas clearly to both engineers and non-technical colleagues.

• You take security, evidence, quality and human accountability seriously.

• You challenge assumptions constructively, including knowing when AI isn't the right answer.

• You care about outcomes, not just activity.

• You build systems others can use without needing you in the loop.



What success looks like:



• A secure, reusable AI architecture is in place and well understood.

• AI agents do approved work reliably, within clear permissions.

• Everyone knows what AI handles, what people review and when to escalate.

• Teams produce more useful work with less repetition and rework.

• AI costs, risks and performance are visible and under control.

• Developers deliver AI features faster using the patterns you set.

• Our AI capabilities deliver measurable benefits for the business and our clients.



How to apply

Send your CV and a short note about an AI system you built and the results it delivered.

title: Projects Coordinator
description:
Project Coordinator, Rent Ready



Position Overview



The Project Coordinator, Rent Ready is a central part of SJA Pros' daily operations, responsible for ensuring maintenance requests and projects move efficiently from initial assignment through completion, documentation, and billing.

This role serves as a primary point of coordination between SJA Pros, subcontractors, residents, and the Maintenance Services Team (MST). The Project Coordinator is responsible for maintaining visibility across active work orders, coordinating schedules, developing accurate scopes and estimates, and ensuring work progresses without unnecessary delays.

Success in this role requires exceptional organization, attention to detail, proactive communication, and a strong sense of ownership. The ideal candidate can balance a high volume of daily service requests while maintaining the accuracy, professionalism, and follow-through necessary to deliver an excellent customer experience.



Key Responsibilities



1. Work Order Intake & Assignment



Receive and review maintenance work orders submitted by MST.

Evaluate work order details, inspection reports, photographs, and supporting documentation to understand the requested work.

Identify the appropriate trade, urgency, and subcontractor requirements.

Assign work to qualified subcontractors based on availability, capabilities, pricing, and project needs.

Provide subcontractors with complete work instructions, supporting documentation, and clear expectations.

Identify incomplete information or potential scope concerns and seek clarification before dispatching work.

Review move-out inspection reports and identify maintenance, repair, cleaning, replacement, and improvement requirements for upcoming unit turns.

Coordinate the assignment of individual scopes to multiple subcontractors based on trade specialization, bid results, availability, and project requirements.



2. Scheduling & Service Coordination



Coordinate scheduling between subcontractors, residents, and internal teams.

Confirm appointment dates, access requirements, and expected service timelines.

Manage rescheduling, cancellations, access difficulties, and other scheduling conflicts.

Maintain accurate, up-to-date scheduling information within company systems.

Anticipate scheduling conflicts and proactively address delays before they affect project completion.

Develop and coordinate unit turn schedules based on property availability, anticipated move-in dates, subcontractor capacity, and project deadlines while ensuring subcontractors meet established scheduling and response-time expectations

Coordinate work sequencing across multiple trades to minimize scheduling conflicts, downtime, and delays in preparing units for occupancy.



3. Work Order Monitoring & Follow-Through

Maintain visibility across active work orders to ensure projects continue progressing toward completion.

Follow up with subcontractors regarding appointment confirmations, progress, outstanding requirements, and expected completion dates.

Identify stalled work orders, recurring delays, and incomplete assignments.

Communicate changes, delays, and service concerns to MST and other appropriate stakeholders.

Escalate complex project issues or operational obstacles when additional support is needed.

Ensure completed work is properly documented and ready for administrative closeout.

Track overall unit turn progress, including approved work, pending items, outstanding repairs, and completion deadlines, to ensure properties remain on track for rent-ready status.



4. Scoping & Estimating



Develop clear, accurate, and actionable scopes of work and estimates for maintenance and construction projects, including:

Unit turns and rent-ready preparations.

Multi-trade repairs and construction projects.

Capital improvements and renovation work.

Projects requiring detailed or insurance-aligned documentation.

Responsibilities include:

Reviewing inspection reports, contractor recommendations, photographs, and property condition documentation.

Translating findings into detailed scopes that clearly define the work to be performed.

Identifying labor, materials, subcontractor requirements, and appropriate work sequencing.

Preparing estimates using established pricing standards and cost considerations.

Developing organized bid packages for subcontractor review and pricing.

Creating professional, customer-facing proposals that explain recommended work, expected outcomes, and relevant considerations.

Identifying opportunities to present alternative solutions that balance cost, property condition, and long-term value.

Prepare and distribute bid requests to qualified subcontractors and evaluate submitted proposals based on pricing, scope accuracy, availability, and subcontractor qualifications.

Compare subcontractor bids and assign individual scopes of work to the most suitable subcontractor based on overall value and project requirements.

Separate required repairs from optional improvements and coordinate owner approvals before authorizing additional work.

Maintain standardized pricing libraries for recurring maintenance and turn-related services.



5. Quality Control & Project Closeout



Review subcontractor completion documentation to verify work aligns with the assigned scope.

Confirm required photographs, service notes, and completion details have been submitted.

Identify incomplete work, discrepancies, or concerns requiring additional review.

Review subcontractor invoices for consistency with approved scopes, labor, materials, and pricing.

Coordinate corrections or request clarification when documentation or invoices are incomplete.

Ensure work orders are accurately updated and closed upon completion.

Provide accurate job-costing and billing information to support timely invoice processing.

Reconcile completed work against approved estimates and submitted invoices, identifying discrepancies, unapproved charges, and cost variances.

 



6. Communication & Customer Service



Maintain clear, professional, and timely communication with residents, subcontractors, MST, and internal team members.

Provide proactive updates regarding project status, scheduling, delays, and next steps.

Communicate project scopes and recommendations in a way that is easy for customers and internal stakeholders to understand.

Anticipate questions and potential concerns to minimize confusion and unnecessary back-and-forth.

Address service issues with professionalism, accountability, and a solutions-oriented approach.

Help establish confidence and trust through consistent communication, accurate information, and dependable follow-through.



7. Documentation & Systems Management



Maintain organized and accurate records for each work order and project.

Ensure scopes, estimates, contractor documentation, photographs, invoices, and communications are properly recorded.

Keep project statuses, scheduling information, and relevant details current within company systems.

Follow established processes for documentation, project tracking, and administrative closeout.

Support the continued development and standardization of estimating templates, workflows, and project documentation.

title: Medical Practice & Executive Virtual Assistant | Long-Term Opportunity
description:
Seeking Medical Practice & Executive Virtual Assistant for a Long-Term Opportunity



Company: Heirloom Family Medicine in Albany, New York, USA 

VA Location: Remote 

Schedule: Full Time

Compensation: $6-9 USD/hour, depending on experience and qualifications, with opportunities for increased compensation as responsibilities grow.





ABOUT HEIRLOOM FAMILY MEDICINE

Hi! I'm Dr. Meghan Monthie, a board-certified family physician and founder of Heirloom Family Medicine, a small but growing independent direct primary care medical practice in Albany, New York, USA (about 2.5 hours north of NYC). 



I created Heirloom in September 2025 because I believe healthcare can (and should!) be better. Heirloom is a direct primary care (DPC) membership-based practice that allows me to spend more time with patients, build meaningful relationships, and provide thoughtful, personalized care, particularly to busy moms who are juggling busy professional careers along with caring for their children, aging parents, and partners. 

You can learn more about the practice on our website and Instagram:







As a solo physician and small business owner, I wear a lot of hats! I'm looking for a reliable, organized, proactive virtual assistant who can help me manage the behind the scenes work of running a small, high-touch medical practice and small business.



My hope is to find someone who help me with my day to day administrative tasks within Heirloom and eventually grow into a trusted, long-term right-hand support as the practice expands.





WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

This position combines medical practice administration, executive assistant responsibilities, and general business operations.



Initially, most of your work will be behind the scenes with limited direct patient communication, although direct patient-facing responsibilities may increase as we work together and based on your interest. 



You won't be expected to know how to do everything on day one. We'll start with shadowing my current workflows before discussing clearly defined responsibilities and expanding your role as we build trust and learn how to work together.





1) Medical Practice Administration

- Organizing and tracking imaging/lab results, referrals, medical records requests, and outstanding administrative tasks

- Following up with prospective patients

- Assisting with new patient onboarding, including organizing and tracking required legal documents and requesting, obtaining, and organizing medical records

- Maintaining accurate spreadsheets to track patient recruitment, onboarding, and retention 

- Helping create and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs)

- Supporting practice workflows and identifying opportunities for improvement

- Triaging patient messages that come in via phone, text, and secure messaging

- Escalating urgent patient concerns to Dr. Meghan 

- Preparing charts for patient appointments - i.e. tracking down and attaching relevant records to notes 





2) Executive & Administrative Support

- Organizing and prioritizing e-mails, tasks, and projects

- Helping manage calendars, scheduling, and deadlines

- Tracking action items and ensuring important tasks don't fall through the cracks

- Conducting online research and gathering information to support decisions

- Organizing files, documents, and digital systems

- Assisting with occasional personal administrative tasks that support my ability to complete my clinical duties, as agreed upon

- Essentially keeping me on task and making me look good! :) 





3) Business Operations & Special Projects

- Helping organize and execute ongoing business projects

- Supporting basic marketing and communications tasks

- Researching software, vendors, and potential solutions

- Creating checklists, templates, and repeatable workflows

- Helping improve efficiency as the practice grows

- Assisting with social media (Instagram,
, Google Business Profile) and e-mail marketing using Canva and Flodesk, if desired and time allows





WHO I'M LOOKING FOR

I'm looking for someone who is:

- Exceptionally organized: You enjoy creating order out of chaos and can keep track of multiple moving pieces. You can keep me  and the millions of ideas in my head on task! 

- Proactive: You're a self starter. You notice what needs to be done, anticipate next steps, and take initiative. 

- Resourceful: You're comfortable researching solutions and figuring things out independently. You think through next steps and use available resources to help answer questions before asking for help, but ask for assistance when appropriate or needed. 

- Detail-oriented: You catch mistakes, follow instructions carefully, and understand that small details matter. 

- A strong communicator: You write clearly in English, ask thoughtful questions, and provide updates without needing to be chased down.

- Dependable: You follow through on commitments and take ownership of your work.

- Tech-savvy: You learn new software quickly and enjoy finding ways to make work easier.

- Adaptable: You're comfortable working in a growing small business where priorities and processes may evolve. 

- Trustworthy: You understand the importance of confidentiality, especially in a small healthcare practice setting.

- Positive and aligned in Heirloom's mission: You enjoy helping others and like to have fun while you do it! 





QUALIFICATIONS

Required:

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Strong organizational and time-management skills

- Proficiency with (or a willingness to learn how to use) Google Workspace (Gmail, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Calendar)

- Experience with administrative support, virtual assistance, or project coordination

- Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote work environment

- Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities



Preferred, but not required:

- Experience supporting a physician, healthcare practice, or other healthcare professional

- Experience working with protected health information (PHI) in a HIPAA-compliant healthcare environment

- Experience as an executive assistant or operations assistant

- Experience with project management tools, Canva, or workflow automation

- Experience creating SOPs and improving administrative processes



Relevant healthcare experience is a huge plus, although a good fit is more important. I'm equally interested in candidates with excellent executive assistant or operations experience who are motivated to learn.







SCHEDULE & COMPENSATION

This is a full-time position (40 hours/week). 



Some availability during US Eastern Time business hours (Monday through Friday, 8AM to 4PM EST) is important for communication and collaboration, although some of this work may eventually be completed independently and on your own schedule. 



Compensation ranges from $6-9 USD/hour, depending on experience, skills, qualifications, and fit with opportunities for increased compensation as responsibilities grow.





WHY WORK WITH ME AT HEIRLOOM 

Heirloom is a small, mission-driven primary care practice with big aspirations.



You'll work directly with me, the physician and founder, and have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on how the practice operates.



I value kindness, integrity, curiosity, thoughtful communication, and people who take ownership of their work.



I'm looking to build a collaborative, respectful working relationship where your ideas and contributions are valued.



For the right person, this is an opportunity to grow into a larger operations and executive support role as Heirloom continues to develop.





HOW TO APPLY

Please complete our application questionnaire:





I'm interested in learning about your experience, how you approach problems, and why this particular opportunity appeals to you.



Please answer thoughtfully and in your own words. I'm looking for someone who is a great fit for this role and our practice, not simply someone who can write a perfect application.





I look forward to hearing from and getting to know you!



Dr. Meghan Monthie

Founder, Heirloom Family Medicine
